あなた:

GitHub Pages 使い方

ChatGPT:

一番簡単なやり方でいきます。使うのはこの1ファイルだけです。

GitHubにログインしたら、次の順番で進めてください。

  1. GitHub右上の 「＋」→「New repository」 を押します。Repository name は family-link-puzzle、公開設定は Public にして Create repository。

  2. 作成した画面で 「Add file」→「Upload files」。さきほどのHTMLファイルをアップロードします。ただしGitHub上のファイル名は必ず index.html にしてください。下の Commit changes を押します。

  3. リポジトリ上部の Settings → Pages を開きます。Build and deployment の Source を Deploy from a branch、Branch を main、Folder を /(root) にして Save。

  4. 数分待つと、通常は
    https://あなたのGitHubユーザー名.github.io/family-link-puzzle/
    でゲームが開きます。

iPhoneではそのURLを Safari で開き、下の共有ボタン → 「ホーム画面に追加」。これで次からはホーム画面のゲームアイコンを押すだけで起動できます。

GitHubの画面をスクショで送ってくれれば、「次はここを押す」だけで1画面ずつ案内します。

あなた:

動かない機種もある？

ChatGPT:

あります。今のゲームは基本的にかなり広いiPhoneで動きますが、古いiOS・Safariや、LINE/Googleアプリ内ブラウザなどではタッチ操作や音が不安定になる可能性があります。SafariのPointer Eventsは世代ごとに改善されていて、古いWebKitにはタッチ系の既知問題もあります。WebKit Bugzilla+1

特に注意したいのは、古いiPhone／古いiOS、Safari以外のアプリ内ブラウザ、メモリの少ない端末です。音についてもiOSではWeb Audioに独自制約があるため、最初のタップ後でないと鳴らない、バックグラウンド復帰後に挙動が変わる、といったケースがあります。WebKit Bugzilla+1

今回のゲームなら、安定性を優先するなら iOS 16以降＋Safari を基準にするのがいいです。ホーム画面追加もSafariのWebアプリ機能で対応できます。Apple Developer+1

さらに互換性を上げるなら、次の修正版で Pointer Events＋Touch Eventsの二重対応、音が鳴らなくてもゲーム継続、低性能端末では演出を軽量化まで入れられます。これをやれば、動かない機種はかなり減らせます。

主な変更は、古いSafari向けのTouch Events対応、音声エラーでもゲーム継続、低性能端末では演出を自動軽量化、バックグラウンド復帰時のタイマー補正、古いiOS向け画面高さ対策です。


GitHubでは今の index.html をこの新版に入れ替えればOKです。

<title>FAMILY LINK PUZZLE - APP STYLE OFFLINE</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#050a23; --navy:#071847; --blue:#168cff; --cyan:#55e7ff;

  --safeT:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top)); --safeB:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#01030e;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","SF Pro Text","Segoe UI","Noto Sans JP",sans-serif;color:white;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:none}
button{font:inherit}
#app{
  position:relative;margin:auto;width:min(100vw,520px);height:var(--appH,100vh);height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;

   radial-gradient(circle at 25% 72%,rgba(0,227,255,.16),transparent 28%),

   linear-gradient(180deg,#07143d 0%,#061238 42%,#061f58 100%);

}
#app::before{

  background-image:radial-gradient(#fff 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:26px 26px;
}
.safeTop{padding-top:var(--safeT)} .safeBottom{padding-bottom:var(--safeB)}

}

/* 起動画面 */
#boot{

}

}

  content:"FL";font-size:58px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-5px;color:white;text-shadow:0 5px 16px #061347bb;
}

/* タイトル */
#home{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:calc(var(--safeT) + 18px) 20px calc(var(--safeB) + 18px)}

}
.fxCard{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;animation:fxPop .8s cubic-bezier(.15,.9,.2,1) both}
.fxCard img{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:46px;object-fit:cover;border:5px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #ffdd67,0 0 55px white}
.fxCard small{display:block;margin-top:20px;color:#fff5a4;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:3px}
.fxCard h2{margin:3px 0;font-size:34px;text-shadow:0 5px 0 #9e1a8c,0 0 18px white}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @keyframes fxPop{0%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}55%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(1)}} @keyframes fxFade{0%{background:#ffffff00}25%{background:#261e7dcc}75%{background:#261e7dcc}100%{background:#ffffff00}}

/* FEVER */
#feverFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;border:0 solid #fff36c;opacity:0}
#feverFx.on{opacity:1;border-width:6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px #fff55d,0 0 45px #ff4bd2;animation:feverPulse .5s infinite alternate}
@keyframes feverPulse{to{box-shadow:inset 0 0 80px #ff4bd2,0 0 55px #53e7ff}}

/* モーダル */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:#01061ad9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.modal.show{display:flex}
.modalCard{width:100%;max-width:390px;border-radius:30px;padding:22px;text-align:center}
.modalCard h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:28px}.modalCard p{margin:0 0 18px;color:#b7c6ee;font-size:13px}
.resultScore{font-size:54px;font-weight:1000;color:#ffe264;text-shadow:0 0 18px #ffbd25;margin:12px 0}
.modalBtn{width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(#56e6ff,#1a8cff);color:#04123c}
.modalBtn.alt{background:linear-gradient(#263d81,#17295f);color:white;border:1px solid #8099dc}

/* 縦画面固定UX */
#rotateOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;background:#020617;color:white;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.rotateBox{max-width:320px}.phoneIcon{font-size:64px;display:block;animation:rotatePhone 1.2s ease infinite alternate}.rotateBox h2{margin:16px 0 8px}.rotateBox p{color:#a9b8e3;line-height:1.5}
@keyframes rotatePhone{from{transform:rotate(90deg)}to{transform:rotate(0)}}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px){#rotateOverlay{display:flex}}

/* Toast */
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:45;left:50%;top:47%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.7);opacity:0;font-size:38px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff56d;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #f12d91,0 0 22px white;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}

#heartClearFx{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:44;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,105,190,.25),rgba(255,30,140,.08) 42%,transparent 72%);
}
#heartClearFx.show{display:flex;animation:heartFade .85s ease both}
#heartClearFx .heart{
  font-size:min(48vw,230px);line-height:1;color:#ff5ca8;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 32px #ff4fbe);
  animation:heartBoom .72s cubic-bezier(.16,.85,.23,1) both;
}
#heartClearFx .spark{
  position:absolute;font-size:30px;color:#fff6a8;animation:sparkOut .72s ease-out both;
}
@keyframes heartBoom{
  0%{transform:scale(.15) rotate(-15deg);opacity:0}
  48%{transform:scale(1.25) rotate(4deg);opacity:1}
  72%{transform:scale(.95) rotate(-2deg)}
  100%{transform:scale(1.55);opacity:0}
}
@keyframes heartFade{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes sparkOut{
  from{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.4);opacity:1}
  to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(1.3);opacity:0}
}


/* ===== iPhone互換性強化 ===== */
html,body{
  min-height:100%;
  height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
#app{
  min-height:100vh;
  min-height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
.lowfx #app::before{display:none!important}
.lowfx #gameWrap{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #54e5ff inset!important}
.lowfx #feverFx.on{animation:none!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px #fff55d!important}
.lowfx .charCard,
.lowfx .glass{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
.lowfx *{text-shadow:none!important}


#compatBadge{
  position:absolute;z-index:90;left:8px;bottom:calc(var(--safeB) + 4px);
  font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#b9c8ef;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <section id="boot" style="display:none">
    <div id="bootLogo"></div>
    <h1>FAMILY LINK</h1>
    <p>PUZZLE</p>
    <div id="bootBar"><i></i></div>
  </section>

  <section id="home" class="screen">
    <div class="appBadge">● OFFLINE</div>
    <div class="homeTitle">
      <div class="miniLogo">FAMILY LINK</div>
      <h1>PUZZLE<span>CONNECT!</span></h1>
    </div>
    <div class="hero glass">
      <div class="heroAvatar"><img id="homeAvatar" alt=""></div>
      <div class="heroCopy">
        <small>LEADER</small>
        <h2 id="homeCharName">キャラ 1</h2>
        <p id="homeCharDesc"></p>
        <div class="heroSkill" id="homeSkill"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btnPlay" id="playBtn">▶ PLAY</button>
    <button class="btn btnSelect" id="selectBtn">キャラクターを選ぶ</button>
    <div class="homeFoot">ハート全消し後は約半分が一気に落下・その後2秒ごと補充<br>5,000点で+5秒・60秒 LINK PUZZLE</div>
  </section>

  <section id="select" class="screen">
    <div class="topbar">
      <button class="backBtn" id="selectBack">‹</button>
      <h2>キャラクター選択</h2><span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="selectIntro">リーダーによってスキルが変わります</div>
    <div class="charGrid" id="charGrid"></div>
    <button class="btn" id="confirmChar">このキャラに決定</button>
  </section>

  <section id="gameScreen" class="screen">
    <div id="gameHud">
      <div class="hudBox glass">SCORE&nbsp;<span id="score">0</span></div>
      <div class="hudBox" id="timer">60</div>
      <div class="hudBox glass">BEST&nbsp;<span id="best">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <button id="pauseBtn">Ⅱ</button>
    <div id="combo"><b id="comboNum">0</b>COMBO</div>
    <div id="gameWrap"><canvas id="game"></canvas></div>
    <div id="gameBottom">
      <div id="leader"><img id="leaderImg" alt=""></div>
      <div id="skillPanel">
        <div id="skillName"></div>
        <div id="skillBar"><div id="skillFill"></div><span id="skillPct">SKILL 0%</span></div>
      </div>
      <button id="skillBtn">SKILL<br>READY</button>
    </div>
    <div id="feverFx"></div>
  </section>

  <div id="heartClearFx">
    <div class="heart">♥</div>
  </div>
  <div id="skillFx">
    <div class="fxCard">
      <img id="fxImg" alt=""><small>CHARACTER SKILL</small><h2 id="fxName"></h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="toast"></div>

  <div class="modal" id="pauseModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <h2>PAUSE</h2><p>ゲームを一時停止しています</p>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="resumeBtn">続ける</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="quitBtn">タイトルへ戻る</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal" id="resultModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <p>TIME UP!</p><h2>RESULT</h2>
      <div class="resultScore" id="resultScore">0</div>
      <div>BEST <b id="resultBest">0</b></div>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="retryBtn">もう一度</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="resultHomeBtn">タイトルへ</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="compatBadge"></div><div id="homeBar"></div>
</div>

<div id="rotateOverlay">
  <div class="rotateBox"><span class="phoneIcon">📱</span><h2>縦画面で遊んでください</h2><p>このゲームはiPhoneの縦向き専用レイアウトです。</p></div>
</div>

<script>

"use strict";

// ===== iPhone / 古いSafari 互換性強化 =====
const SUPPORTS_POINTER = ("PointerEvent" in window);
const IS_IOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
               (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
const OLD_IOS = (() => {
  const m = navigator.userAgent.match(/OS (\d+)_/);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) < 16 : false;
})();
const LOW_MEMORY = Number(navigator.deviceMemory || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_CPU = Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_FX = OLD_IOS || LOW_MEMORY || LOW_CPU;

if (LOW_FX) document.documentElement.classList.add("lowfx");

// 画面高さを古いiOSでも安定させる
function applyViewportHeight(){
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH", window.innerHeight + "px");
}
applyViewportHeight();
window.addEventListener("resize", applyViewportHeight, {passive:true});
window.addEventListener("orientationchange", () => setTimeout(applyViewportHeight, 180), {passive:true});

// 古いSafariで Array.prototype.at が無い場合
if (!Array.prototype.at) {
  Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, "at", {
    value: function(n){
      n = Math.trunc(n) || 0;
      if (n < 0) n += this.length;
      if (n < 0 || n >= this.length) return undefined;
      return this[n];
    },
    writable: true,
    configurable: true
  });
}

// safe vibrate

  try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(v); } catch(e) {}
}

const CHARS = [
  {name:"キャラ 1", skill:"ハート全消し", desc:"大きなハート演出で盤面のキャラを全部消す", type:"heartclear"},
  {name:"キャラ 2", skill:"タイムプラス", desc:"時間を5秒回復し、ランダムに6個消す", type:"time"},
  {name:"キャラ 3", skill:"ボムラッシュ", desc:"盤面の3か所を連続爆破する", type:"bomb"},
  {name:"キャラ 4", skill:"スコアブースト", desc:"7秒間、獲得スコアが3倍になる", type:"boost"},
  {name:"キャラ 5", skill:"カラーチェンジ", desc:"8個をリーダーの顔に変化させる", type:"convert"},
  {name:"キャラ 6", skill:"フィーバー", desc:"8秒間のFEVERに即突入する", type:"fever"},
  {name:"キャラ 7", skill:"オールクリア", desc:"ランダムに18個を一気に消す", type:"clear"}
];

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const canvas=$("#game"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"), wrap=$("#gameWrap");
const images=AVATARS.map(src=>{const i=new Image();i.src=src;return i;});

let selectedChar = Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLeader")||0);
if(!Number.isFinite(selectedChar)||selectedChar<0||selectedChar>6) selectedChar=0;
let tempChar=selectedChar;

const COLS=6,ROWS=8,TYPES=7;
let board=[], selecting=[], particles=[];
let running=false, paused=false, score=0, combo=0, timeLeft=60, skill=0;
let fever=false, feverEnd=0, scoreBoost=false, boostEnd=0, lastClearAt=0, lastTick=0;
let nextTimeBonusScore=5000;
const TIME_BONUS_STEP=5000, TIME_BONUS_SEC=5;
let dpr=1,W=0,H=0,cell=0,ox=0,oy=0,audioCtx=null,soundOn=true;
let lastGravity=0,lastSpawn=0,massDropUntil=0;
const GRAVITY_MS=105, SPAWN_MS=2000, MOVE_MS=190;

function setAppHeight(){document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH",innerHeight+"px")}
addEventListener("resize",()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()});
addEventListener("orientationchange",()=>setTimeout(()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()},180));
setAppHeight();

document.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{if(running)e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("gesturestart",e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("dblclick",e=>e.preventDefault());

function showScreen(id){
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("active"));
  $(id).classList.add("active");
}
function unlockAudio(){
  try{
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if(!AC) return false;
    if(!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AC();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      const p = audioCtx.resume();
      if(p && typeof p.catch === "function") p.catch(()=>{});
    }
    // iOSで無音バッファを一度鳴らしてロック解除
    if(IS_IOS && audioCtx.createBufferSource){
      const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
      const buf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
      src.buffer = buf;
      src.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      try { src.start(0); } catch(e) {}
    }
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    soundOn = false;
    return false;
  }
}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener("touchstart",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});

function beep(freq=500,dur=.06,vol=.03,type="sine"){
  if(!soundOn) return;
  try{
    if(!unlockAudio() || !audioCtx) return;
    const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(), g=audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type=type;
    o.frequency.value=freq;
    g.gain.value=vol;
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const now=audioCtx.currentTime;
    o.start(now);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(vol,.0002), now);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now+dur);
    o.stop(now+dur+.02);
  }catch(e){
    // 音声エラーが出てもゲームは止めない
  }
}
function haptic(v=8){ safeVibrate(v); }

function updateHome(){
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  $("#homeAvatar").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#homeCharName").textContent=c.name;$("#homeCharDesc").textContent=c.desc;$("#homeSkill").textContent="✦ "+c.skill;
  $("#leaderImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#skillName").textContent="SKILL : "+c.skill;
}
function buildCharGrid(){
  const g=$("#charGrid");g.innerHTML="";
  CHARS.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement("button");b.className="charCard"+(i===tempChar?" selected":"");b.dataset.i=i;
    b.style.borderColor=CHAR_COLORS[i].main+"88";
    b.style.boxShadow="0 8px 22px #0005, inset 0 0 0 1px "+CHAR_COLORS[i].glow+"44";
    b.innerHTML=`<img src="${AVATARS[i]}" style="border-color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].main}"><div><strong style="color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].light}">${c.name}</strong><small>${c.skill}<br>${c.desc}</small></div><i class="check">✓</i>`;
    b.onclick=()=>{tempChar=i;buildCharGrid();beep(540+i*35,.04,.02)};
    g.appendChild(b);
  })
}

setTimeout(()=>{$("#boot").style.display="none";updateHome();startGame()},0);

$("#playBtn").onclick=()=>startGame();
$("#selectBtn").onclick=()=>{tempChar=selectedChar;buildCharGrid();showScreen("#select")};
$("#selectBack").onclick=()=>showScreen("#home");
$("#confirmChar").onclick=()=>{
  selectedChar=tempChar;localStorage.setItem("familyLeader",selectedChar);updateHome();showScreen("#home");beep(760,.08,.03);haptic(12)
};

function randType(){return Math.floor(Math.random()*TYPES)}
function makeCell(fromRow=null){return {type:randType(),moveFromRow:fromRow,moveStart:performance.now()}}
function resetBoard(){board=Array.from({length:ROWS},()=>Array.from({length:COLS},makeCell));selecting=[];particles=[]}
function resizeCanvas(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(); if(!r.width||!r.height)return;
  dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.floor(r.width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.floor(r.height*dpr);
  canvas.style.width=r.width+"px";canvas.style.height=r.height+"px";ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  W=r.width;H=r.height;cell=Math.min(W/COLS,H/ROWS);ox=(W-cell*COLS)/2;oy=(H-cell*ROWS)/2;
}
function pos(r,c){
  const stagger=(r%2?cell*.08:-cell*.04);
  return{x:ox+c*cell+cell/2+stagger,y:oy+r*cell+cell/2}
}
function hit(x,y){
  const c=Math.floor((x-ox)/cell),r=Math.floor((y-oy)/cell);if(r<0||r>=ROWS||c<0||c>=COLS)return null;
  const p=pos(r,c),dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y;return dx*dx+dy*dy<=(cell*.43)**2?{r,c}:null;
}
function same(a,b){return a&&b&&a.r===b.r&&a.c===b.c}
function adj(a,b){return Math.max(Math.abs(a.r-b.r),Math.abs(a.c-b.c))<=1}
function selIndex(h){return selecting.findIndex(v=>same(v,h))}
function pointerXY(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  if(!running||paused)return;try{ if(canvas.setPointerCapture) canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(_e){}const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);
  if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){selecting=[h];beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);haptic(4)}
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
  if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c])return;
  const last=selecting.at(-1);if(same(h,last))return;
  if(selecting.length>=2&&same(h,selecting.at(-2))){selecting.pop();return}
  if(selIndex(h)>=0)return;
  const first=selecting[0];if(adj(last,h)&&board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){selecting.push(h);beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);haptic(3)}
});
function pointerEnd(){if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;if(selecting.length>=3)clearChain(selecting);else beep(150,.06,.018,"square");selecting=[]}
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup",pointerEnd);
canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel",pointerEnd);

// Pointer Events非対応端末向け Touch Events フォールバック
if(!SUPPORTS_POINTER){
  let touchActive=false;

  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e=>{
    if(!running||paused) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){
      selecting=[h];
      touchActive=true;
      beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);
      haptic(4);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e=>{
    if(!running||paused||!touchActive||!selecting.length) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c]) return;

    const last=selecting[selecting.length-1];
    if(same(h,last)) return;

    if(selecting.length>=2 && same(h,selecting[selecting.length-2])){
      selecting.pop();
      return;
    }
    if(selIndex(h)>=0) return;

    const first=selecting[0];
    if(adj(last,h) && board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){
      selecting.push(h);
      beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);
      haptic(3);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  const endTouch=()=>{
    if(!touchActive) return;
    touchActive=false;
    pointerEnd();
  };
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend",endTouch,{passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel",endTouch,{passive:false});
}


function addParticles(r,c,type,n=8){ if(LOW_FX) n=Math.min(n,3);
  const p=pos(r,c);for(let k=0;k<n;k++)particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4-1,life:1,type})
}
function clearCells(set,baseN=3,withScore=true){
  let count=0;for(const key of set){const[r,c]=key.split(",").map(Number);if(board[r]?.[c]){addParticles(r,c,board[r][c].type);board[r][c]=null;count++}}
  if(withScore&&count){
    let multi=1;if(fever)multi*=2;if(scoreBoost)multi*=3;
    score+=Math.round((baseN*baseN*10+count*9)*(1+Math.min(combo,12)*.05)*multi);
    $("#score").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");

    // 5,000点到達ごとに残り時間を5秒回復
    let bonusCount=0;
    while(score>=nextTimeBonusScore){
      bonusCount++;
      nextTimeBonusScore+=TIME_BONUS_STEP;
    }
    if(bonusCount>0){
      const addSec=TIME_BONUS_SEC*bonusCount;
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+addSec);
      $("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;
      showToast("SCORE BONUS +" + addSec + " SEC");
      beep(1040,.10,.035,"sine");
      setTimeout(()=>beep(1280,.12,.03,"sine"),90);
      haptic([12,18,18]);
    }
  }
  return count;
}
function clearChain(chain){
  const now=performance.now();combo=(now-lastClearAt<2200)?combo+1:1;lastClearAt=now;$("#comboNum").textContent=combo;
  const set=new Set(chain.map(p=>p.r+","+p.c));
  if(chain.length>=7){const z=chain.at(-1);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let r=z.r+dr,c=z.c+dc;if(r>=0&&r<ROWS&&c>=0&&c<COLS)set.add(r+","+c)}showToast("BOMB!")}
  const n=clearCells(set,chain.length,true);
  skill=Math.min(100,skill+n*5.4);updateSkill();
  beep(470+n*16,.07,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(660+n*12,.07,.025),45);
  wrap.animate(
    [{transform:"scale(1)"},{transform:"scale(1.008)"},{transform:"scale(1)"}],
    {duration:160,easing:"ease-out"}
  );
  haptic(chain.length>=7?[14,20,20]:8);
  if(chain.length>=12&&!fever)startFever();
}
function gravityStep(){
  let moved=false;
  for(let r=ROWS-1;r>=1;r--){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(!board[r][c] && board[r-1][c]){
        const b=board[r-1][c];
        board[r][c]=b;
        board[r-1][c]=null;
        b.moveFromRow=r-1;
        b.moveStart=performance.now();
        moved=true;
      }
    }
  }
  return moved;
}
function spawnOne(){
  const candidates=[];
  for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    if(!board[0][c]) candidates.push(c);
  }
  if(!candidates.length) return false;
  const c=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
  board[0][c]=makeCell(-1);
  return true;
}
function occupiedCount(){
  let n=0;
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])n++;
  return n;
}
function updateSkill(){
  $("#skillFill").style.width=skill+"%";$("#skillPct").textContent="SKILL "+Math.floor(skill)+"%";$("#skillBtn").classList.toggle("ready",skill>=100)
}
function randomCells(n){
  const a=[];for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])a.push([r,c]);
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}
  return a.slice(0,n)
}
function skillAnimation(){
  $("#fxImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#fxName").textContent=CHARS[selectedChar].skill;$("#skillFx").classList.add("show");
  beep(760,.12,.045);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.15,.04),100);setTimeout(()=>$("#skillFx").classList.remove("show"),1000)
}
function useSkill(){
  if(!running||paused||skill<100)return;skill=0;updateSkill();skillAnimation();haptic([20,30,35]);
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(c.type==="heartclear"){
      showHeartClear();
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const s=new Set();
        for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
          for(let col=0;col<COLS;col++){
            if(board[r][col]) s.add(r+","+col);
          }
        }
        clearCells(s,22,true);
        showToast("♥ ALL CLEAR ♥");
        haptic([25,30,45]);

        // 全消しの余韻のあと、約半分を一気に上から降らせる
        setTimeout(()=>massDropHalfBoard(),520);
      },260)
    }else if(c.type==="time"){
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+5);$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;const s=new Set(randomCells(6).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,6,true);showToast("+5 SEC")
    }else if(c.type==="bomb"){
      let s=new Set();for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const r=Math.floor(Math.random()*ROWS),col=Math.floor(Math.random()*COLS);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let rr=r+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr>=0&&rr<ROWS&&cc>=0&&cc<COLS)s.add(rr+","+cc)}}clearCells(s,10,true)
    }else if(c.type==="boost"){
      scoreBoost=true;boostEnd=performance.now()+7000;showToast("SCORE ×3")
    }else if(c.type==="convert"){
      randomCells(8).forEach(([r,col])=>{if(board[r][col])board[r][col].type=selectedChar});showToast("COLOR CHANGE")
    }else if(c.type==="fever"){
      startFever()
    }else if(c.type==="clear"){
      const s=new Set(randomCells(18).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,12,true);showToast("ALL CLEAR!")
    }
  },420)
}
$("#skillBtn").onclick=useSkill;

function startFever(){
  // FEVER突入時：画面上のキャラをすべて消す
  const all = new Set();
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(board[r][c]) all.add(r+","+c);
    }
  }
  clearCells(all, 20, true);

  fever=true;
  feverEnd=performance.now()+8000;
  $("#feverFx").classList.add("on");
  showToast("FEVER! ALL CLEAR");
  beep(900,.14,.04);
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1150,.18,.04),120);
  haptic([25,35,45]);
}
function stopFever(){fever=false;$("#feverFx").classList.remove("on")}
function showToast(t){const e=$("#toast");e.textContent=t;e.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(showToast.t);showToast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove("show"),650)}

function showHeartClear(){
  const fx=$("#heartClearFx");
  fx.querySelectorAll(".spark").forEach(e=>e.remove());
  const marks=["♥","✦","♡","✧","♥","✦","♡","✧"];
  marks.forEach((m,i)=>{
    const s=document.createElement("span");
    s.className="spark";
    s.textContent=m;
    const a=(Math.PI*2/marks.length)*i;
    const d=90+Math.random()*85;
    s.style.setProperty("--dx",Math.cos(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.setProperty("--dy",Math.sin(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.left="50%";s.style.top="50%";
    s.style.marginLeft="-12px";s.style.marginTop="-12px";
    fx.appendChild(s);
  });
  fx.classList.remove("show");
  void fx.offsetWidth;
  fx.classList.add("show");
  beep(880,.11,.04,"sine");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1180,.16,.04,"triangle"),100);
  setTimeout(()=>fx.classList.remove("show"),850);
}


function massDropHalfBoard(){
  // 盤面の約半分＝下4段×6列＝24個を、上空から一斉に降らせる
  const start=performance.now();
  for(let r=ROWS-4;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      const b=makeCell(-4-Math.random()*2);
      b.moveStart=start;
      board[r][c]=b;
    }
  }
  // 一斉落下アニメーション中は通常重力/1個ずつ補充を一時停止
  massDropUntil=start+520;
  lastGravity=massDropUntil;
  lastSpawn=massDropUntil;
  showToast("♥ HALF DROP! ♥");
  beep(720,.08,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(920,.10,.03,"triangle"),90);
  haptic([18,24,28]);
}


function drawAvatar(im,x,y,r,selected,phase=0,type=0){
  ctx.save();

  const col=CHAR_COLORS[type]||CHAR_COLORS[0];
  const fit=FACE_FITS[type]||FACE_FITS[0];
  const t=performance.now();
  const bob=Math.sin(t/520+phase)*1.5;
  const squish=selected?1.06:(1+Math.sin(t/680+phase)*0.01);

  ctx.translate(x,y+bob);
  ctx.scale(squish,1/squish*1.01);

  const br=r*fit.body;

  // 影
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=.32;
  ctx.fillStyle="#000";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,br*.73,br*.72,br*.28,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  if(!LOW_FX) ctx.filter="blur(5px)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // ぬいぐるみ本体
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor=selected?"#fff":col.glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur=selected?20:11;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-br,-br,br,br);
  g.addColorStop(0,col.light);
  g.addColorStop(.50,"#fff");
  g.addColorStop(1,col.main);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // 手
  ctx.fillStyle=col.light;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(-br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,-.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  // 顔表示：キャラごとに輪郭へ合わせた楕円＋個別拡大
  ctx.save();
  const fx=br*fit.ovalX, fy=br*fit.ovalY;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.clip();

  if(im.complete){
    const iw=im.naturalWidth, ih=im.naturalHeight;
    const base=Math.min((fx*2)/iw,(fy*2)/ih);
    const s=base*fit.scale;
    const dw=iw*s, dh=ih*s;
    const dx=-dw/2 + br*fit.x;
    const dy=-dh/2 - br*.03 + br*fit.y;
    ctx.drawImage(im,dx,dy,dw,dh);
  }

  const shine=ctx.createRadialGradient(-br*.30,-br*.38,2,-br*.18,-br*.23,br*.68);
  shine.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.42)");
  shine.addColorStop(.45,"rgba(255,255,255,.07)");
  shine.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=shine;
  ctx.fillRect(-br,-br,br*2,br*2);
  ctx.restore();

  // 顔輪郭の縁取り
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.88)";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // 本体のキャラ色枠
  ctx.strokeStyle=selected?"#fff36a":col.main;
  ctx.lineWidth=selected?5:4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  if(selected){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle=col.glow;
    ctx.lineWidth=6;
    ctx.shadowColor=col.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0,0,br*1.10,br*.98,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.12;ctx.fillStyle="#6edfff";for(let y=15;y<H;y+=34)for(let x=15;x<W;x+=34){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore();
  if(selecting.length>1){ctx.save();
    const chainType=board[selecting[0].r][selecting[0].c].type;
    const chainColor=CHAR_COLORS[chainType].glow;
    ctx.strokeStyle=chainColor;
    ctx.lineWidth=10;
    ctx.lineCap="round";
    ctx.lineJoin="round";
    ctx.shadowColor=chainColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur=20;ctx.beginPath();selecting.forEach((q,i)=>{const p=pos(q.r,q.c);i?ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y):ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)});ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    const b=board[r]?.[c];if(!b)continue;
    const p=pos(r,c),idx=selIndex({r,c});
    let py=p.y;
    if(b.moveFromRow!==null && b.moveFromRow!==undefined){
      const t=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-b.moveStart)/MOVE_MS);
      const ease=t<.78 ? 1-Math.pow(1-t/.78,3) : 1 + Math.sin((t-.78)/.22*Math.PI)*.05*(1-(t-.78)/.22);
      const fromY=oy+b.moveFromRow*cell+cell/2;
      py=fromY+(p.y-fromY)*ease;
      if(t>=1)b.moveFromRow=null;
    }
    drawAvatar(images[b.type],p.x,py,cell*.405*(idx>=0?1.05:1),idx>=0,(r*7+c)*0.67,b.type);
    if(idx>=0){
      ctx.save();
      const rr=Math.max(10,cell*.15);
      ctx.fillStyle=CHAR_COLORS[b.type].main;
      ctx.shadowColor="#000";ctx.shadowBlur=6;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,py,rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle="#fff";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
      ctx.font=`900 ${Math.max(11,cell*.18)}px system-ui`;
      ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
      ctx.fillText(idx+1,p.x,py);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=.05;p.life-=.035;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);ctx.fillStyle=["#ff6bde","#62eaff","#ffe35c","#8dff7a","#ff8e6a","#b98bff","#fff"][p.type%7];ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,4+4*p.life,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0)
}
let __lastFrame=0;
function loop(ts){
  if(LOW_FX && ts-__lastFrame<33){requestAnimationFrame(loop);return;}
  __lastFrame=ts;
  draw();
  if(running&&!paused){
    if(!lastTick)lastTick=ts;
    if(ts-lastTick>=1000){const n=Math.floor((ts-lastTick)/1000);timeLeft=Math.max(0,timeLeft-n);lastTick+=n*1000;$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;if(timeLeft<=10)$("#timer").style.color="#ffe15a";if(timeLeft<=0)finishGame()}
    const now=performance.now();
    if(!lastGravity)lastGravity=now;
    if(!lastSpawn)lastSpawn=now;
    if(now>=massDropUntil){
      if(now-lastGravity>=GRAVITY_MS){
        gravityStep();
        lastGravity=now;
      }
      if(now-lastSpawn>=SPAWN_MS){
        if(occupiedCount()<ROWS*COLS) spawnOne();
        lastSpawn=now;
      }
    }
    if(fever&&now>=feverEnd)stopFever();
    if(scoreBoost&&now>=boostEnd){scoreBoost=false;showToast("BOOST END")}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop)
}
function resetGame(){
  score=0;combo=0;timeLeft=60;skill=0;fever=false;scoreBoost=false;lastClearAt=0;lastTick=0;lastGravity=0;lastSpawn=0;massDropUntil=0;nextTimeBonusScore=TIME_BONUS_STEP;paused=false;
  $("#score").textContent="0";$("#comboNum").textContent="0";$("#timer").textContent="60";$("#timer").style.color="white";updateSkill();stopFever();resetBoard()
}
function startGame(){
  unlockAudio();resetGame();updateHome();showScreen("#gameScreen");setTimeout(resizeCanvas,50);running=true;beep(650,.07,.03);setTimeout(()=>beep(850,.09,.03),75);
  try{screen.orientation?.lock?.("portrait").catch(()=>{})}catch(e){}
}
function finishGame(){
  if(!running)return;running=false;let best=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0);if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem("familyLinkBest",best)}
  $("#best").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultScore").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultBest").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultModal").classList.add("show");beep(220,.2,.04,"triangle")
}
$("#best").textContent=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0).toLocaleString("ja-JP");
$("#pauseBtn").onclick=()=>{if(!running)return;paused=true;$("#pauseModal").classList.add("show")};
$("#resumeBtn").onclick=()=>{paused=false;lastTick=performance.now();$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show")};
$("#quitBtn").onclick=()=>{running=false;paused=false;$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#retryBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#resultHomeBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};

resetBoard();updateHome();requestAnimationFrame(loop);

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{
  if(document.hidden){
    if(running) paused=true;
  }else{
    lastTick=performance.now();
    lastGravity=performance.now();
    lastSpawn=performance.now();
    // 自動復帰。音は次のタップで再アンロック
    if(running) paused=false;
  }
});

// iOSのページキャッシュから復帰した時にもタイマー補正
window.addEventListener("pageshow",()=>{
  lastTick=performance.now();
  lastGravity=performance.now();
  lastSpawn=performance.now();
},{passive:true});


try{
  const b=document.getElementById("compatBadge");
  if(b) b.textContent = LOW_FX ? "互換モード" : "標準モード";
}catch(e){}

</script>
</body>
</html>

簡単です。今ある index.html を新版で上書きすればOKです。

まず新版を保存してください。

保存したら、PC上でファイル名を index.html に変更します。

そのあとGitHubの family-link-puzzle を開いて、

  1. Code 画面を開く

  2. Add file → Upload files

  3. 新しい index.html をドラッグ

  4. 同じ名前の既存ファイルがあるので、内容が新版に置き換わります

  5. 下の Commit changes を押す

これだけです。

<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>

<meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#06133d">
<title>FAMILY LINK PUZZLE - APP STYLE OFFLINE</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#050a23; --navy:#071847; --blue:#168cff; --cyan:#55e7ff;
  --pink:#ff4bd2; --gold:#ffd65a; --white:#fff; --muted:#a8b9e7;
  --safeT:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top)); --safeB:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#01030e;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","SF Pro Text","Segoe UI","Noto Sans JP",sans-serif;color:white;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:none}
button{font:inherit}
#app{
  position:relative;margin:auto;width:min(100vw,520px);height:var(--appH,100vh);height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;
  background:
   radial-gradient(circle at 50% 12%,rgba(60,118,255,.55),transparent 30%),
   radial-gradient(circle at 25% 72%,rgba(0,227,255,.16),transparent 28%),
   radial-gradient(circle at 90% 58%,rgba(255,0,198,.14),transparent 28%),
   linear-gradient(180deg,#07143d 0%,#061238 42%,#061f58 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 60px #000;
}
#app::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.18;
  background-image:radial-gradient(#fff 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:26px 26px;
}
.safeTop{padding-top:var(--safeT)} .safeBottom{padding-bottom:var(--safeB)}
.screen{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;z-index:10}
.screen.active{display:flex}
.glass{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,54,139,.92),rgba(7,24,75,.92));
  border:1px solid rgba(124,226,255,.65);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
}
.pill{border-radius:999px}

/* 起動画面 */
#boot{
  display:flex;z-index:50;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;
  background:
   radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,rgba(79,109,255,.7),transparent 34%),
   linear-gradient(180deg,#081b58,#04081d 72%);
}
#bootLogo{
  width:152px;height:152px;border-radius:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#42e7ff,#5267ff 48%,#ff4bd2);
  box-shadow:0 18px 55px #1e76ff77,0 0 0 1px #ffffff55 inset;
  animation:bootPop 1.25s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1) both;
}
#bootLogo::after{
  content:"FL";font-size:58px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-5px;color:white;text-shadow:0 5px 16px #061347bb;
}
#boot h1{font-size:30px;margin:24px 0 4px;letter-spacing:1px}
#boot p{margin:0;color:#b9c8f5;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:12px}
#bootBar{width:180px;height:5px;border-radius:5px;background:#ffffff22;margin-top:28px;overflow:hidden}
#bootBar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#55e7ff,#ff4bd2);animation:loadBar 1.35s ease forwards}
@keyframes bootPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.7) rotate(-6deg)}55%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.07) rotate(2deg)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes loadBar{to{width:100%}}

/* タイトル */
#home{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:calc(var(--safeT) + 18px) 20px calc(var(--safeB) + 18px)}
.appBadge{position:absolute;top:calc(var(--safeT) + 5px);left:14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#8fffe0;background:#071d3ecc;border:1px solid #60ffd6;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.homeTitle{text-align:center;margin-top:38px}
.homeTitle .miniLogo{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#82eaff;font-weight:900}
.homeTitle h1{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:42px;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-1.5px;text-shadow:0 5px 22px #1639ff}
.homeTitle h1 span{display:block;color:#ff58dc}
.hero{
  width:100%;max-width:390px;margin:28px auto 18px;padding:16px;border-radius:32px;position:relative;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
}
.heroAvatar{
  width:106px;height:106px;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid white;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #5fe8ff55,0 10px 26px #0007;flex:none;
}
.heroAvatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.heroCopy{min-width:0}
.heroCopy small{color:#8aefff;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px}
.heroCopy h2{margin:4px 0 5px;font-size:22px}
.heroCopy p{margin:0;color:#c5d2f5;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
.heroSkill{
  margin-top:8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;
  background:#ff4bd222;border:1px solid #ff80e6;color:#ffd8f7;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;
}
.btn{
  border:0;color:white;font-weight:1000;border-radius:22px;padding:16px 18px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px #0007,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff55;transition:.12s transform;
}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btnPlay{width:100%;max-width:390px;font-size:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff63de,#d719b7);border:1px solid #ffb5ef}
.btnSelect{width:100%;max-width:390px;margin-top:12px;font-size:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a6dd5,#0d3b99);border:1px solid #6cecff}
.homeFoot{margin-top:auto;color:#8397cc;font-size:11px;text-align:center;line-height:1.6}

/* キャラ選択 */
#select{flex-direction:column;padding:calc(var(--safeT) + 12px) 14px calc(var(--safeB) + 12px)}
.topbar{height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.backBtn{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffffff55;background:#102d73;color:white;font-size:22px}
.topbar h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}
.topbar span{width:42px}
.selectIntro{text-align:center;margin:10px 0 12px;color:#a7b8e7;font-size:13px}
.charGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:11px;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:8px}
.charCard{
  border-radius:24px;padding:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:relative;border:1px solid #ffffff22;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(23,60,151,.88),rgba(7,21,68,.92));
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0005;
}
.charCard.selected{border:2px solid #ffd65a;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffd65a33,0 10px 25px #0007}
.charCard img{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:20px;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #fff}
.charCard strong{display:block;font-size:14px}
.charCard small{display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;color:#b9c8ef;margin-top:3px}
.check{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:8px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd65a;color:#3b2a00;font-weight:1000;place-items:center}
.charCard.selected .check{display:grid}
#confirmChar{margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(#54e5ff,#168cff);color:#06133d;font-size:18px}

/* ゲーム */
#gameScreen{flex-direction:column;z-index:5;padding-top:var(--safeT);padding-bottom:var(--safeB)}
#gameHud{height:86px;padding:8px 10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 76px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.hudBox{height:50px;border-radius:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;font-weight:1000}
#timer{
  width:68px;height:68px;margin:auto;border-radius:50%;font-size:30px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%,#9ff7ff,#25c9ef 54%,#076abd);
  border:4px solid #eaffff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #218bd8,0 0 18px #42e7ff;
}
#pauseBtn{position:absolute;right:12px;top:calc(var(--safeT) + 88px);z-index:9;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffffff66;background:#102b6dcc;color:white}
#combo{
  position:absolute;right:18px;top:calc(var(--safeT) + 130px);z-index:9;text-align:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:13px;
  color:#d9f8ff;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000;
}
#combo b{display:block;font-size:34px;color:#ff61df;line-height:.9}
#gameWrap{
  position:relative;margin:0 9px;border-radius:34px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-height:0;
  border:3px solid #ff62df;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%,rgba(100,140,255,.28),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 20% 70%,rgba(255,80,210,.12),transparent 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 80% 68%,rgba(70,230,255,.12),transparent 26%),linear-gradient(180deg,#163c9a,#081a54 72%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #54e5ff inset,0 0 22px #ff4bd277;
}
#game{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
#gameBottom{height:92px;padding:10px 14px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#leader{
  width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #7cecff;box-shadow:0 0 15px #4de8ff;position:relative;flex:none;
}
#leader img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
#skillPanel{flex:1;min-width:0}
#skillName{font-size:11px;color:#b9ccf5;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 4px 6px}
#skillBar{height:34px;border:2px solid white;border-radius:18px;background:#110c47;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#skillFill{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff4bd2,#885cff,#4be7ff);transition:width .2s}
#skillBar span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:12px;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}
#skillBtn{
  width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #6979a8;background:radial-gradient(circle,#213d83,#0b1741);
  color:#8fa3d6;font-weight:1000;font-size:10px;line-height:1.05;flex:none;transition:.2s;
}
#skillBtn.ready{
  border-color:#ffe875;color:white;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ff7ada,#a829d4 58%,#3a1a83);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffe87533,0 0 24px #ff67da;animation:readyPulse .8s infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes readyPulse{to{transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #ffe87522,0 0 32px #ff6bdc}}
#homeBar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:120px;height:5px;border-radius:10px;background:#ffffffaa;z-index:30}

/* スキル演出 */
#skillFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:40;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#skillFx.show{display:flex;animation:fxFade 1.05s ease both}
#skillFx::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:140vmax;height:140vmax;border-radius:50%;
  background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,#ffffff00,#57eaff88,#ff59ddaa,#fff56c99,#57eaff88,#ffffff00);
  animation:spin .75s linear infinite;
}
.fxCard{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;animation:fxPop .8s cubic-bezier(.15,.9,.2,1) both}
.fxCard img{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:46px;object-fit:cover;border:5px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #ffdd67,0 0 55px white}
.fxCard small{display:block;margin-top:20px;color:#fff5a4;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:3px}
.fxCard h2{margin:3px 0;font-size:34px;text-shadow:0 5px 0 #9e1a8c,0 0 18px white}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @keyframes fxPop{0%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}55%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(1)}} @keyframes fxFade{0%{background:#ffffff00}25%{background:#261e7dcc}75%{background:#261e7dcc}100%{background:#ffffff00}}

/* FEVER */
#feverFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;border:0 solid #fff36c;opacity:0}
#feverFx.on{opacity:1;border-width:6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px #fff55d,0 0 45px #ff4bd2;animation:feverPulse .5s infinite alternate}
@keyframes feverPulse{to{box-shadow:inset 0 0 80px #ff4bd2,0 0 55px #53e7ff}}

/* モーダル */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:#01061ad9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.modal.show{display:flex}
.modalCard{width:100%;max-width:390px;border-radius:30px;padding:22px;text-align:center}
.modalCard h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:28px}.modalCard p{margin:0 0 18px;color:#b7c6ee;font-size:13px}
.resultScore{font-size:54px;font-weight:1000;color:#ffe264;text-shadow:0 0 18px #ffbd25;margin:12px 0}
.modalBtn{width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(#56e6ff,#1a8cff);color:#04123c}
.modalBtn.alt{background:linear-gradient(#263d81,#17295f);color:white;border:1px solid #8099dc}

/* 縦画面固定UX */
#rotateOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;background:#020617;color:white;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.rotateBox{max-width:320px}.phoneIcon{font-size:64px;display:block;animation:rotatePhone 1.2s ease infinite alternate}.rotateBox h2{margin:16px 0 8px}.rotateBox p{color:#a9b8e3;line-height:1.5}
@keyframes rotatePhone{from{transform:rotate(90deg)}to{transform:rotate(0)}}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px){#rotateOverlay{display:flex}}

/* Toast */
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:45;left:50%;top:47%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.7);opacity:0;font-size:38px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff56d;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #f12d91,0 0 22px white;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}

#heartClearFx{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:44;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,105,190,.25),rgba(255,30,140,.08) 42%,transparent 72%);
}
#heartClearFx.show{display:flex;animation:heartFade .85s ease both}
#heartClearFx .heart{
  font-size:min(48vw,230px);line-height:1;color:#ff5ca8;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 32px #ff4fbe);
  animation:heartBoom .72s cubic-bezier(.16,.85,.23,1) both;
}
#heartClearFx .spark{
  position:absolute;font-size:30px;color:#fff6a8;animation:sparkOut .72s ease-out both;
}
@keyframes heartBoom{
  0%{transform:scale(.15) rotate(-15deg);opacity:0}
  48%{transform:scale(1.25) rotate(4deg);opacity:1}
  72%{transform:scale(.95) rotate(-2deg)}
  100%{transform:scale(1.55);opacity:0}
}
@keyframes heartFade{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes sparkOut{
  from{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.4);opacity:1}
  to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(1.3);opacity:0}
}


/* ===== iPhone互換性強化 ===== */
html,body{
  min-height:100%;
  height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
#app{
  min-height:100vh;
  min-height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
.lowfx #app::before{display:none!important}
.lowfx #gameWrap{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #54e5ff inset!important}
.lowfx #feverFx.on{animation:none!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px #fff55d!important}
.lowfx .charCard,
.lowfx .glass{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
.lowfx *{text-shadow:none!important}


#compatBadge{
  position:absolute;z-index:90;left:8px;bottom:calc(var(--safeB) + 4px);
  font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#b9c8ef;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

  </section>

  <section id="select" class="screen">
    <div class="topbar">
      <button class="backBtn" id="selectBack">‹</button>
      <h2>キャラクター選択</h2><span></span>
    </div>

  </section>

  <section id="gameScreen" class="screen">
    <div id="gameHud">
      <div class="hudBox glass">SCORE&nbsp;<span id="score">0</span></div>
      <div class="hudBox" id="timer">60</div>
      <div class="hudBox glass">BEST&nbsp;<span id="best">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <button id="pauseBtn">Ⅱ</button>
    <div id="combo"><b id="comboNum">0</b>COMBO</div>
    <div id="gameWrap"><canvas id="game"></canvas></div>
    <div id="gameBottom">
      <div id="leader"><img id="leaderImg" alt=""></div>
      <div id="skillPanel">
        <div id="skillName"></div>
        <div id="skillBar"><div id="skillFill"></div><span id="skillPct">SKILL 0%</span></div>
      </div>

    </div>
    <div id="feverFx"></div>
  </section>

  <div id="heartClearFx">
    <div class="heart">♥</div>
  </div>
  <div id="skillFx">
    <div class="fxCard">
      <img id="fxImg" alt=""><small>CHARACTER SKILL</small><h2 id="fxName"></h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="toast"></div>

  <div class="modal" id="pauseModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <h2>PAUSE</h2><p>ゲームを一時停止しています</p>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="resumeBtn">続ける</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="quitBtn">タイトルへ戻る</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal" id="resultModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <p>TIME UP!</p><h2>RESULT</h2>
      <div class="resultScore" id="resultScore">0</div>
      <div>BEST <b id="resultBest">0</b></div>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="retryBtn">もう一度</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="resultHomeBtn">タイトルへ</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="compatBadge"></div><div id="homeBar"></div>
</div>

<div id="rotateOverlay">
  <div class="rotateBox"><span class="phoneIcon">📱</span><h2>縦画面で遊んでください</h2><p>このゲームはiPhoneの縦向き専用レイアウトです。</p></div>

<script>

"use strict";

// ===== iPhone / 古いSafari 互換性強化 =====
const SUPPORTS_POINTER = ("PointerEvent" in window);
const IS_IOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
               (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
const OLD_IOS = (() => {
  const m = navigator.userAgent.match(/OS (\d+)_/);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) < 16 : false;
})();
const LOW_MEMORY = Number(navigator.deviceMemory || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_CPU = Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_FX = OLD_IOS || LOW_MEMORY || LOW_CPU;

if (LOW_FX) document.documentElement.classList.add("lowfx");

// 画面高さを古いiOSでも安定させる
function applyViewportHeight(){
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH", window.innerHeight + "px");
}
applyViewportHeight();
window.addEventListener("resize", applyViewportHeight, {passive:true});
window.addEventListener("orientationchange", () => setTimeout(applyViewportHeight, 180), {passive:true});

// 古いSafariで Array.prototype.at が無い場合
if (!Array.prototype.at) {
  Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, "at", {
    value: function(n){
      n = Math.trunc(n) || 0;
      if (n < 0) n += this.length;
      if (n < 0 || n >= this.length) return undefined;
      return this[n];
    },
    writable: true,
    configurable: true
  });
}

// safe vibrate
function safeVibrate(v){
  try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(v); } catch(e) {}
}

const CHARS = [
  {name:"キャラ 1", skill:"ハート全消し", desc:"大きなハート演出で盤面のキャラを全部消す", type:"heartclear"},
  {name:"キャラ 2", skill:"タイムプラス", desc:"時間を5秒回復し、ランダムに6個消す", type:"time"},
  {name:"キャラ 3", skill:"ボムラッシュ", desc:"盤面の3か所を連続爆破する", type:"bomb"},
  {name:"キャラ 4", skill:"スコアブースト", desc:"7秒間、獲得スコアが3倍になる", type:"boost"},
  {name:"キャラ 5", skill:"カラーチェンジ", desc:"8個をリーダーの顔に変化させる", type:"convert"},
  {name:"キャラ 6", skill:"フィーバー", desc:"8秒間のFEVERに即突入する", type:"fever"},
  {name:"キャラ 7", skill:"オールクリア", desc:"ランダムに18個を一気に消す", type:"clear"}
];

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const canvas=$("#game"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"), wrap=$("#gameWrap");
const images=AVATARS.map(src=>{const i=new Image();i.src=src;return i;});

let selectedChar = Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLeader")||0);
if(!Number.isFinite(selectedChar)||selectedChar<0||selectedChar>6) selectedChar=0;
let tempChar=selectedChar;

const COLS=6,ROWS=8,TYPES=7;
let board=[], selecting=[], particles=[];
let running=false, paused=false, score=0, combo=0, timeLeft=60, skill=0;
let fever=false, feverEnd=0, scoreBoost=false, boostEnd=0, lastClearAt=0, lastTick=0;
let nextTimeBonusScore=5000;
const TIME_BONUS_STEP=5000, TIME_BONUS_SEC=5;
let dpr=1,W=0,H=0,cell=0,ox=0,oy=0,audioCtx=null,soundOn=true;
let lastGravity=0,lastSpawn=0,massDropUntil=0;
const GRAVITY_MS=105, SPAWN_MS=2000, MOVE_MS=190;

function setAppHeight(){document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH",innerHeight+"px")}
addEventListener("resize",()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()});
addEventListener("orientationchange",()=>setTimeout(()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()},180));
setAppHeight();

document.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{if(running)e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("gesturestart",e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("dblclick",e=>e.preventDefault());

function showScreen(id){
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("active"));
  $(id).classList.add("active");
}
function unlockAudio(){
  try{
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if(!AC) return false;
    if(!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AC();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      const p = audioCtx.resume();
      if(p && typeof p.catch === "function") p.catch(()=>{});
    }
    // iOSで無音バッファを一度鳴らしてロック解除
    if(IS_IOS && audioCtx.createBufferSource){
      const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
      const buf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
      src.buffer = buf;
      src.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      try { src.start(0); } catch(e) {}
    }
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    soundOn = false;
    return false;
  }
}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener("touchstart",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});

function beep(freq=500,dur=.06,vol=.03,type="sine"){
  if(!soundOn) return;
  try{
    if(!unlockAudio() || !audioCtx) return;
    const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(), g=audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type=type;
    o.frequency.value=freq;
    g.gain.value=vol;
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const now=audioCtx.currentTime;
    o.start(now);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(vol,.0002), now);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now+dur);
    o.stop(now+dur+.02);
  }catch(e){
    // 音声エラーが出てもゲームは止めない
  }
}
function haptic(v=8){ safeVibrate(v); }

function updateHome(){
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  $("#homeAvatar").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#homeCharName").textContent=c.name;$("#homeCharDesc").textContent=c.desc;$("#homeSkill").textContent="✦ "+c.skill;
  $("#leaderImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#skillName").textContent="SKILL : "+c.skill;
}
function buildCharGrid(){
  const g=$("#charGrid");g.innerHTML="";
  CHARS.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement("button");b.className="charCard"+(i===tempChar?" selected":"");b.dataset.i=i;
    b.style.borderColor=CHAR_COLORS[i].main+"88";
    b.style.boxShadow="0 8px 22px #0005, inset 0 0 0 1px "+CHAR_COLORS[i].glow+"44";
    b.innerHTML=`<img src="${AVATARS[i]}" style="border-color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].main}"><div><strong style="color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].light}">${c.name}</strong><small>${c.skill}<br>${c.desc}</small></div><i class="check">✓</i>`;
    b.onclick=()=>{tempChar=i;buildCharGrid();beep(540+i*35,.04,.02)};
    g.appendChild(b);
  })
}

setTimeout(()=>{$("#boot").style.display="none";updateHome();startGame()},0);

$("#playBtn").onclick=()=>startGame();
$("#selectBtn").onclick=()=>{tempChar=selectedChar;buildCharGrid();showScreen("#select")};
$("#selectBack").onclick=()=>showScreen("#home");
$("#confirmChar").onclick=()=>{
  selectedChar=tempChar;localStorage.setItem("familyLeader",selectedChar);updateHome();showScreen("#home");beep(760,.08,.03);haptic(12)
};

function randType(){return Math.floor(Math.random()*TYPES)}
function makeCell(fromRow=null){return {type:randType(),moveFromRow:fromRow,moveStart:performance.now()}}
function resetBoard(){board=Array.from({length:ROWS},()=>Array.from({length:COLS},makeCell));selecting=[];particles=[]}
function resizeCanvas(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(); if(!r.width||!r.height)return;
  dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.floor(r.width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.floor(r.height*dpr);
  canvas.style.width=r.width+"px";canvas.style.height=r.height+"px";ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  W=r.width;H=r.height;cell=Math.min(W/COLS,H/ROWS);ox=(W-cell*COLS)/2;oy=(H-cell*ROWS)/2;
}
function pos(r,c){
  const stagger=(r%2?cell*.08:-cell*.04);
  return{x:ox+c*cell+cell/2+stagger,y:oy+r*cell+cell/2}
}
function hit(x,y){
  const c=Math.floor((x-ox)/cell),r=Math.floor((y-oy)/cell);if(r<0||r>=ROWS||c<0||c>=COLS)return null;
  const p=pos(r,c),dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y;return dx*dx+dy*dy<=(cell*.43)**2?{r,c}:null;
}
function same(a,b){return a&&b&&a.r===b.r&&a.c===b.c}
function adj(a,b){return Math.max(Math.abs(a.r-b.r),Math.abs(a.c-b.c))<=1}
function selIndex(h){return selecting.findIndex(v=>same(v,h))}
function pointerXY(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  if(!running||paused)return;try{ if(canvas.setPointerCapture) canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(_e){}const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);
  if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){selecting=[h];beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);haptic(4)}
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
  if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c])return;
  const last=selecting.at(-1);if(same(h,last))return;
  if(selecting.length>=2&&same(h,selecting.at(-2))){selecting.pop();return}
  if(selIndex(h)>=0)return;
  const first=selecting[0];if(adj(last,h)&&board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){selecting.push(h);beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);haptic(3)}
});
function pointerEnd(){if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;if(selecting.length>=3)clearChain(selecting);else beep(150,.06,.018,"square");selecting=[]}
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup",pointerEnd);
canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel",pointerEnd);

// Pointer Events非対応端末向け Touch Events フォールバック
if(!SUPPORTS_POINTER){
  let touchActive=false;

  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e=>{
    if(!running||paused) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){
      selecting=[h];
      touchActive=true;
      beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);
      haptic(4);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e=>{
    if(!running||paused||!touchActive||!selecting.length) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c]) return;

    const last=selecting[selecting.length-1];
    if(same(h,last)) return;

    if(selecting.length>=2 && same(h,selecting[selecting.length-2])){
      selecting.pop();
      return;
    }
    if(selIndex(h)>=0) return;

    const first=selecting[0];
    if(adj(last,h) && board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){
      selecting.push(h);
      beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);
      haptic(3);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  const endTouch=()=>{
    if(!touchActive) return;
    touchActive=false;
    pointerEnd();
  };
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend",endTouch,{passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel",endTouch,{passive:false});
}


function addParticles(r,c,type,n=8){ if(LOW_FX) n=Math.min(n,3);
  const p=pos(r,c);for(let k=0;k<n;k++)particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4-1,life:1,type})
}
function clearCells(set,baseN=3,withScore=true){
  let count=0;for(const key of set){const[r,c]=key.split(",").map(Number);if(board[r]?.[c]){addParticles(r,c,board[r][c].type);board[r][c]=null;count++}}
  if(withScore&&count){
    let multi=1;if(fever)multi*=2;if(scoreBoost)multi*=3;
    score+=Math.round((baseN*baseN*10+count*9)*(1+Math.min(combo,12)*.05)*multi);
    $("#score").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");

    // 5,000点到達ごとに残り時間を5秒回復
    let bonusCount=0;
    while(score>=nextTimeBonusScore){
      bonusCount++;
      nextTimeBonusScore+=TIME_BONUS_STEP;
    }
    if(bonusCount>0){
      const addSec=TIME_BONUS_SEC*bonusCount;
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+addSec);
      $("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;
      showToast("SCORE BONUS +" + addSec + " SEC");
      beep(1040,.10,.035,"sine");
      setTimeout(()=>beep(1280,.12,.03,"sine"),90);
      haptic([12,18,18]);
    }
  }
  return count;
}
function clearChain(chain){
  const now=performance.now();combo=(now-lastClearAt<2200)?combo+1:1;lastClearAt=now;$("#comboNum").textContent=combo;
  const set=new Set(chain.map(p=>p.r+","+p.c));
  if(chain.length>=7){const z=chain.at(-1);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let r=z.r+dr,c=z.c+dc;if(r>=0&&r<ROWS&&c>=0&&c<COLS)set.add(r+","+c)}showToast("BOMB!")}
  const n=clearCells(set,chain.length,true);
  skill=Math.min(100,skill+n*5.4);updateSkill();
  beep(470+n*16,.07,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(660+n*12,.07,.025),45);
  wrap.animate(
    [{transform:"scale(1)"},{transform:"scale(1.008)"},{transform:"scale(1)"}],
    {duration:160,easing:"ease-out"}
  );
  haptic(chain.length>=7?[14,20,20]:8);
  if(chain.length>=12&&!fever)startFever();
}
function gravityStep(){
  let moved=false;
  for(let r=ROWS-1;r>=1;r--){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(!board[r][c] && board[r-1][c]){
        const b=board[r-1][c];
        board[r][c]=b;
        board[r-1][c]=null;
        b.moveFromRow=r-1;
        b.moveStart=performance.now();
        moved=true;
      }
    }
  }
  return moved;
}
function spawnOne(){
  const candidates=[];
  for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    if(!board[0][c]) candidates.push(c);
  }
  if(!candidates.length) return false;
  const c=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
  board[0][c]=makeCell(-1);
  return true;
}
function occupiedCount(){
  let n=0;
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])n++;
  return n;
}
function updateSkill(){
  $("#skillFill").style.width=skill+"%";$("#skillPct").textContent="SKILL "+Math.floor(skill)+"%";$("#skillBtn").classList.toggle("ready",skill>=100)
}
function randomCells(n){
  const a=[];for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])a.push([r,c]);
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}
  return a.slice(0,n)
}
function skillAnimation(){
  $("#fxImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#fxName").textContent=CHARS[selectedChar].skill;$("#skillFx").classList.add("show");
  beep(760,.12,.045);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.15,.04),100);setTimeout(()=>$("#skillFx").classList.remove("show"),1000)
}
function useSkill(){
  if(!running||paused||skill<100)return;skill=0;updateSkill();skillAnimation();haptic([20,30,35]);
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(c.type==="heartclear"){
      showHeartClear();
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const s=new Set();
        for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
          for(let col=0;col<COLS;col++){
            if(board[r][col]) s.add(r+","+col);
          }
        }
        clearCells(s,22,true);
        showToast("♥ ALL CLEAR ♥");
        haptic([25,30,45]);

        // 全消しの余韻のあと、約半分を一気に上から降らせる
        setTimeout(()=>massDropHalfBoard(),520);
      },260)
    }else if(c.type==="time"){
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+5);$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;const s=new Set(randomCells(6).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,6,true);showToast("+5 SEC")
    }else if(c.type==="bomb"){
      let s=new Set();for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const r=Math.floor(Math.random()*ROWS),col=Math.floor(Math.random()*COLS);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let rr=r+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr>=0&&rr<ROWS&&cc>=0&&cc<COLS)s.add(rr+","+cc)}}clearCells(s,10,true)
    }else if(c.type==="boost"){
      scoreBoost=true;boostEnd=performance.now()+7000;showToast("SCORE ×3")
    }else if(c.type==="convert"){
      randomCells(8).forEach(([r,col])=>{if(board[r][col])board[r][col].type=selectedChar});showToast("COLOR CHANGE")
    }else if(c.type==="fever"){
      startFever()
    }else if(c.type==="clear"){
      const s=new Set(randomCells(18).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,12,true);showToast("ALL CLEAR!")
    }
  },420)
}
$("#skillBtn").onclick=useSkill;

function startFever(){
  // FEVER突入時：画面上のキャラをすべて消す
  const all = new Set();
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(board[r][c]) all.add(r+","+c);
    }
  }
  clearCells(all, 20, true);

  fever=true;
  feverEnd=performance.now()+8000;
  $("#feverFx").classList.add("on");
  showToast("FEVER! ALL CLEAR");
  beep(900,.14,.04);
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1150,.18,.04),120);
  haptic([25,35,45]);
}
function stopFever(){fever=false;$("#feverFx").classList.remove("on")}
function showToast(t){const e=$("#toast");e.textContent=t;e.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(showToast.t);showToast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove("show"),650)}

function showHeartClear(){
  const fx=$("#heartClearFx");
  fx.querySelectorAll(".spark").forEach(e=>e.remove());
  const marks=["♥","✦","♡","✧","♥","✦","♡","✧"];
  marks.forEach((m,i)=>{
    const s=document.createElement("span");
    s.className="spark";
    s.textContent=m;
    const a=(Math.PI*2/marks.length)*i;
    const d=90+Math.random()*85;
    s.style.setProperty("--dx",Math.cos(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.setProperty("--dy",Math.sin(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.left="50%";s.style.top="50%";
    s.style.marginLeft="-12px";s.style.marginTop="-12px";
    fx.appendChild(s);
  });
  fx.classList.remove("show");
  void fx.offsetWidth;
  fx.classList.add("show");
  beep(880,.11,.04,"sine");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1180,.16,.04,"triangle"),100);
  setTimeout(()=>fx.classList.remove("show"),850);
}


function massDropHalfBoard(){
  // 盤面の約半分＝下4段×6列＝24個を、上空から一斉に降らせる
  const start=performance.now();
  for(let r=ROWS-4;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      const b=makeCell(-4-Math.random()*2);
      b.moveStart=start;
      board[r][c]=b;
    }
  }
  // 一斉落下アニメーション中は通常重力/1個ずつ補充を一時停止
  massDropUntil=start+520;
  lastGravity=massDropUntil;
  lastSpawn=massDropUntil;
  showToast("♥ HALF DROP! ♥");
  beep(720,.08,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(920,.10,.03,"triangle"),90);
  haptic([18,24,28]);
}


function drawAvatar(im,x,y,r,selected,phase=0,type=0){
  ctx.save();

  const col=CHAR_COLORS[type]||CHAR_COLORS[0];
  const fit=FACE_FITS[type]||FACE_FITS[0];
  const t=performance.now();
  const bob=Math.sin(t/520+phase)*1.5;
  const squish=selected?1.06:(1+Math.sin(t/680+phase)*0.01);

  ctx.translate(x,y+bob);
  ctx.scale(squish,1/squish*1.01);

  const br=r*fit.body;

  // 影
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=.32;
  ctx.fillStyle="#000";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,br*.73,br*.72,br*.28,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  if(!LOW_FX) ctx.filter="blur(5px)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // ぬいぐるみ本体
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor=selected?"#fff":col.glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur=selected?20:11;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-br,-br,br,br);
  g.addColorStop(0,col.light);
  g.addColorStop(.50,"#fff");
  g.addColorStop(1,col.main);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // 手
  ctx.fillStyle=col.light;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(-br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,-.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  // 顔表示：キャラごとに輪郭へ合わせた楕円＋個別拡大
  ctx.save();
  const fx=br*fit.ovalX, fy=br*fit.ovalY;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.clip();

  if(im.complete){
    const iw=im.naturalWidth, ih=im.naturalHeight;
    const base=Math.min((fx*2)/iw,(fy*2)/ih);
    const s=base*fit.scale;
    const dw=iw*s, dh=ih*s;
    const dx=-dw/2 + br*fit.x;
    const dy=-dh/2 - br*.03 + br*fit.y;
    ctx.drawImage(im,dx,dy,dw,dh);
  }

  const shine=ctx.createRadialGradient(-br*.30,-br*.38,2,-br*.18,-br*.23,br*.68);
  shine.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.42)");
  shine.addColorStop(.45,"rgba(255,255,255,.07)");
  shine.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=shine;
  ctx.fillRect(-br,-br,br*2,br*2);
  ctx.restore();

  // 顔輪郭の縁取り
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.88)";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // 本体のキャラ色枠
  ctx.strokeStyle=selected?"#fff36a":col.main;
  ctx.lineWidth=selected?5:4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  if(selected){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle=col.glow;
    ctx.lineWidth=6;
    ctx.shadowColor=col.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0,0,br*1.10,br*.98,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.12;ctx.fillStyle="#6edfff";for(let y=15;y<H;y+=34)for(let x=15;x<W;x+=34){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore();
  if(selecting.length>1){ctx.save();
    const chainType=board[selecting[0].r][selecting[0].c].type;
    const chainColor=CHAR_COLORS[chainType].glow;
    ctx.strokeStyle=chainColor;
    ctx.lineWidth=10;
    ctx.lineCap="round";
    ctx.lineJoin="round";
    ctx.shadowColor=chainColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur=20;ctx.beginPath();selecting.forEach((q,i)=>{const p=pos(q.r,q.c);i?ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y):ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)});ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    const b=board[r]?.[c];if(!b)continue;
    const p=pos(r,c),idx=selIndex({r,c});
    let py=p.y;
    if(b.moveFromRow!==null && b.moveFromRow!==undefined){
      const t=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-b.moveStart)/MOVE_MS);
      const ease=t<.78 ? 1-Math.pow(1-t/.78,3) : 1 + Math.sin((t-.78)/.22*Math.PI)*.05*(1-(t-.78)/.22);
      const fromY=oy+b.moveFromRow*cell+cell/2;
      py=fromY+(p.y-fromY)*ease;
      if(t>=1)b.moveFromRow=null;
    }
    drawAvatar(images[b.type],p.x,py,cell*.405*(idx>=0?1.05:1),idx>=0,(r*7+c)*0.67,b.type);
    if(idx>=0){
      ctx.save();
      const rr=Math.max(10,cell*.15);
      ctx.fillStyle=CHAR_COLORS[b.type].main;
      ctx.shadowColor="#000";ctx.shadowBlur=6;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,py,rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle="#fff";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
      ctx.font=`900 ${Math.max(11,cell*.18)}px system-ui`;
      ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
      ctx.fillText(idx+1,p.x,py);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=.05;p.life-=.035;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);ctx.fillStyle=["#ff6bde","#62eaff","#ffe35c","#8dff7a","#ff8e6a","#b98bff","#fff"][p.type%7];ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,4+4*p.life,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0)
}
let __lastFrame=0;
function loop(ts){
  if(LOW_FX && ts-__lastFrame<33){requestAnimationFrame(loop);return;}
  __lastFrame=ts;
  draw();
  if(running&&!paused){
    if(!lastTick)lastTick=ts;
    if(ts-lastTick>=1000){const n=Math.floor((ts-lastTick)/1000);timeLeft=Math.max(0,timeLeft-n);lastTick+=n*1000;$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;if(timeLeft<=10)$("#timer").style.color="#ffe15a";if(timeLeft<=0)finishGame()}
    const now=performance.now();
    if(!lastGravity)lastGravity=now;
    if(!lastSpawn)lastSpawn=now;
    if(now>=massDropUntil){
      if(now-lastGravity>=GRAVITY_MS){
        gravityStep();
        lastGravity=now;
      }
      if(now-lastSpawn>=SPAWN_MS){
        if(occupiedCount()<ROWS*COLS) spawnOne();
        lastSpawn=now;
      }
    }
    if(fever&&now>=feverEnd)stopFever();
    if(scoreBoost&&now>=boostEnd){scoreBoost=false;showToast("BOOST END")}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop)
}
function resetGame(){
  score=0;combo=0;timeLeft=60;skill=0;fever=false;scoreBoost=false;lastClearAt=0;lastTick=0;lastGravity=0;lastSpawn=0;massDropUntil=0;nextTimeBonusScore=TIME_BONUS_STEP;paused=false;
  $("#score").textContent="0";$("#comboNum").textContent="0";$("#timer").textContent="60";$("#timer").style.color="white";updateSkill();stopFever();resetBoard()
}
function startGame(){
  unlockAudio();resetGame();updateHome();showScreen("#gameScreen");setTimeout(resizeCanvas,50);running=true;beep(650,.07,.03);setTimeout(()=>beep(850,.09,.03),75);
  try{screen.orientation?.lock?.("portrait").catch(()=>{})}catch(e){}
}
function finishGame(){
  if(!running)return;running=false;let best=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0);if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem("familyLinkBest",best)}
  $("#best").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultScore").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultBest").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultModal").classList.add("show");beep(220,.2,.04,"triangle")
}
$("#best").textContent=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0).toLocaleString("ja-JP");
$("#pauseBtn").onclick=()=>{if(!running)return;paused=true;$("#pauseModal").classList.add("show")};
$("#resumeBtn").onclick=()=>{paused=false;lastTick=performance.now();$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show")};
$("#quitBtn").onclick=()=>{running=false;paused=false;$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#retryBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#resultHomeBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};

resetBoard();updateHome();requestAnimationFrame(loop);

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{
  if(document.hidden){
    if(running) paused=true;
  }else{
    lastTick=performance.now();
    lastGravity=performance.now();
    lastSpawn=performance.now();
    // 自動復帰。音は次のタップで再アンロック
    if(running) paused=false;
  }
});

// iOSのページキャッシュから復帰した時にもタイマー補正
window.addEventListener("pageshow",()=>{
  lastTick=performance.now();
  lastGravity=performance.now();
  lastSpawn=performance.now();
},{passive:true});


try{
  const b=document.getElementById("compatBadge");
  if(b) b.textContent = LOW_FX ? "互換モード" : "標準モード";
}catch(e){}

</script>
</body>
</html>

button{font:inherit}
#app{

@keyframes bootPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.7) rotate(-6deg)}55%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.07) rotate(2deg)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}

#feverFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;border:0 solid #fff36c;opacity:0}

/* モーダル */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:#01061ad9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}

.modalBtn.alt{background:linear-gradient(#263d81,#17295f);color:white;border:1px solid #8099dc}

/* 縦画面固定UX */
#rotateOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;background:#020617;color:white;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.rotateBox{max-width:320px}.phoneIcon{font-size:64px;display:block;animation:rotatePhone 1.2s ease infinite alternate}.rotateBox h2{margin:16px 0 8px}.rotateBox p{color:#a9b8e3;line-height:1.5}
@keyframes rotatePhone{from{transform:rotate(90deg)}to{transform:rotate(0)}}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:650px){#rotateOverlay{display:flex}}

/* Toast */
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:45;left:50%;top:47%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.7);opacity:0;font-size:38px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff56d;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #f12d91,0 0 22px white;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}

#heartClearFx{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:44;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,105,190,.25),rgba(255,30,140,.08) 42%,transparent 72%);
}
#heartClearFx.show{display:flex;animation:heartFade .85s ease both}
#heartClearFx .heart{
  font-size:min(48vw,230px);line-height:1;color:#ff5ca8;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 32px #ff4fbe);
  animation:heartBoom .72s cubic-bezier(.16,.85,.23,1) both;
}
#heartClearFx .spark{
  position:absolute;font-size:30px;color:#fff6a8;animation:sparkOut .72s ease-out both;
}
@keyframes heartBoom{
  0%{transform:scale(.15) rotate(-15deg);opacity:0}
  48%{transform:scale(1.25) rotate(4deg);opacity:1}
  72%{transform:scale(.95) rotate(-2deg)}
  100%{transform:scale(1.55);opacity:0}
}
@keyframes heartFade{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes sparkOut{
  from{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.4);opacity:1}
  to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(1.3);opacity:0}
}


/* ===== iPhone互換性強化 ===== */
html,body{
  min-height:100%;
  height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
#app{
  min-height:100vh;
  min-height:-webkit-fill-available;
}
.lowfx #app::before{display:none!important}
.lowfx #gameWrap{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #54e5ff inset!important}
.lowfx #feverFx.on{animation:none!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px #fff55d!important}

.lowfx .glass{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}

  opacity:.95;
  transition:opacity .35s ease;

</style>
