    <button class="btn btnPlay" id="playBtn">▶ PLAY</button>
    <button class="btn btnSelect" id="selectBtn">キャラクターを選ぶ</button>
    <div class="homeFoot">ハート全消し後は約半分が一気に落下・その後2秒ごと補充<br>5,000点で+5秒・60秒 LINK PUZZLE</div>
  </section>

  <section id="select" class="screen">
    <div class="topbar">
      <button class="backBtn" id="selectBack">‹</button>
      <h2>キャラクター選択</h2><span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="selectIntro">リーダーによってスキルが変わります</div>
    <div class="charGrid" id="charGrid"></div>
    <button class="btn" id="confirmChar">このキャラに決定</button>
  </section>

  <section id="gameScreen" class="screen">
    <div id="gameHud">
      <div class="hudBox glass">SCORE&nbsp;<span id="score">0</span></div>
      <div class="hudBox" id="timer">60</div>
      <div class="hudBox glass">BEST&nbsp;<span id="best">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <button id="pauseBtn">Ⅱ</button><button id="musicBtn" aria-label="BGM">♪</button><div id="musicHint">画面をタップするとBGM開始</div>
    <div id="combo"><b id="comboNum">0</b>COMBO</div>
    <div id="gameWrap"><canvas id="game"></canvas></div>
    <div id="gameBottom">
      <div id="leader"><img id="leaderImg" alt=""></div>
      <div id="skillPanel">
        <div id="skillName"></div>
        <div id="skillBar"><div id="skillFill"></div><span id="skillPct">SKILL 0%</span></div>
      </div>
      <button id="skillBtn">SKILL<br>READY</button>
    </div>
    <div id="feverFx"></div>
  </section>

  <div id="heartClearFx">
    <div class="heart">♥</div>
  </div>
  <div id="skillFx">
    <div class="fxCard">
      <img id="fxImg" alt=""><small>CHARACTER SKILL</small><h2 id="fxName"></h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="toast"></div>

  <div class="modal" id="pauseModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <h2>PAUSE</h2><p>ゲームを一時停止しています</p>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="resumeBtn">続ける</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="quitBtn">タイトルへ戻る</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal" id="resultModal">
    <div class="modalCard glass">
      <p>TIME UP!</p><h2>RESULT</h2>
      <div class="resultScore" id="resultScore">0</div>
      <div>BEST <b id="resultBest">0</b></div>
      <button class="btn modalBtn" id="retryBtn">もう一度</button>
      <button class="btn modalBtn alt" id="resultHomeBtn">タイトルへ</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="compatBadge"></div><div id="homeBar"></div>
</div>

<div id="rotateOverlay">
  <div class="rotateBox"><span class="phoneIcon">📱</span><h2>縦画面で遊んでください</h2><p>このゲームはiPhoneの縦向き専用レイアウトです。</p></div>
</div>

<script>

"use strict";

// ===== iPhone / 古いSafari 互換性強化 =====
const SUPPORTS_POINTER = ("PointerEvent" in window);
const IS_IOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
               (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
const OLD_IOS = (() => {
  const m = navigator.userAgent.match(/OS (\d+)_/);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) < 16 : false;
})();
const LOW_MEMORY = Number(navigator.deviceMemory || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_CPU = Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) <= 2;
const LOW_FX = OLD_IOS || LOW_MEMORY || LOW_CPU;

if (LOW_FX) document.documentElement.classList.add("lowfx");

// 画面高さを古いiOSでも安定させる
function applyViewportHeight(){
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH", window.innerHeight + "px");
}
applyViewportHeight();
window.addEventListener("resize", applyViewportHeight, {passive:true});
window.addEventListener("orientationchange", () => setTimeout(applyViewportHeight, 180), {passive:true});

// 古いSafariで Array.prototype.at が無い場合
if (!Array.prototype.at) {
  Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, "at", {
    value: function(n){
      n = Math.trunc(n) || 0;
      if (n < 0) n += this.length;
      if (n < 0 || n >= this.length) return undefined;
      return this[n];
    },
    writable: true,
    configurable: true
  });
}

// safe vibrate
function safeVibrate(v){
  try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(v); } catch(e) {}
}

// FULL OFFLINE BUILD: no network, no CDN, no API.

// ===== オフラインBGM =====
let bgmEnabled = true;
let bgmTimer = null;
let bgmStep = 0;
let bgmStarted = false;
let bgmMaster = null;

const BGM_NOTES = [
  523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 659.25,
  587.33, 698.46, 880.00, 698.46,
  493.88, 659.25, 783.99, 987.77,
  587.33, 698.46, 783.99, 659.25
];

const BGM_BASS = [
  130.81,130.81,146.83,146.83,
  123.47,123.47,146.83,146.83
];

function ensureBgmMaster(){
  if(!audioCtx) return false;
  if(!bgmMaster){
    bgmMaster = audioCtx.createGain();
    bgmMaster.gain.value = .045;
    bgmMaster.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  }
  return true;
}

function bgmTone(freq, when, dur, vol=.035, type="triangle"){
  try{
    if(!audioCtx || !bgmMaster) return;
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type = type;
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, when);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, when);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, when + .025);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, when + dur);
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(bgmMaster);
    o.start(when);
    o.stop(when + dur + .03);
  }catch(e){}
}

function scheduleBgmStep(){
  if(!bgmEnabled || !audioCtx || !ensureBgmMaster()) return;
  const now = audioCtx.currentTime + .03;

  const note = BGM_NOTES[bgmStep % BGM_NOTES.length];
  bgmTone(note, now, .24, .030, "triangle");

  if(bgmStep % 2 === 0){
    const bass = BGM_BASS[Math.floor(bgmStep/2) % BGM_BASS.length];
    bgmTone(bass, now, .34, .020, "sine");
  }

  if(bgmStep % 4 === 3){
    bgmTone(note * 2, now + .02, .10, .012, "sine");
  }

  bgmStep++;
}

function startBGM(){
  if(!bgmEnabled) return;
  if(!unlockAudio()) return;
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  ensureBgmMaster();

  if(bgmStarted) return;
  bgmStarted = true;

  scheduleBgmStep();
  bgmTimer = setInterval(scheduleBgmStep, 300);

  const hint=document.getElementById("musicHint");
  if(hint) hint.classList.add("hide");
}

function stopBGM(){
  bgmStarted = false;
  if(bgmTimer){
    clearInterval(bgmTimer);
    bgmTimer = null;
  }
}

function setBGM(on){
  bgmEnabled = !!on;
  const btn=document.getElementById("musicBtn");
  if(btn){
    btn.textContent = bgmEnabled ? "♪" : "×";
    btn.classList.toggle("off", !bgmEnabled);
  }
  if(bgmEnabled){
    startBGM();
  }else{
    stopBGM();
  }
  try{ localStorage.setItem("familyLinkBGM", bgmEnabled ? "1" : "0"); }catch(e){}
}

try{
  const saved = localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBGM");
  if(saved === "0") bgmEnabled = false;
}catch(e){}

function firstMusicGesture(){
  if(bgmEnabled) startBGM();
}
document.addEventListener("touchstart", firstMusicGesture, {once:true, passive:true});
document.addEventListener("pointerdown", firstMusicGesture, {once:true, passive:true});
document.addEventListener("click", firstMusicGesture, {once:true, passive:true});

const CHARS = [
  {name:"キャラ 1", skill:"ハート全消し", desc:"大きなハート演出で盤面のキャラを全部消す", type:"heartclear"},
  {name:"キャラ 2", skill:"タイムプラス", desc:"時間を5秒回復し、ランダムに6個消す", type:"time"},
  {name:"キャラ 3", skill:"ボムラッシュ", desc:"盤面の3か所を連続爆破する", type:"bomb"},
  {name:"キャラ 4", skill:"スコアブースト", desc:"7秒間、獲得スコアが3倍になる", type:"boost"},
  {name:"キャラ 5", skill:"カラーチェンジ", desc:"8個をリーダーの顔に変化させる", type:"convert"},
  {name:"キャラ 6", skill:"フィーバー", desc:"8秒間のFEVERに即突入する", type:"fever"},
  {name:"キャラ 7", skill:"オールクリア", desc:"ランダムに18個を一気に消す", type:"clear"}
];

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const canvas=$("#game"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"), wrap=$("#gameWrap");
const images=AVATARS.map(src=>{const i=new Image();i.src=src;return i;});

let selectedChar = Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLeader")||0);
if(!Number.isFinite(selectedChar)||selectedChar<0||selectedChar>6) selectedChar=0;
let tempChar=selectedChar;

const COLS=6,ROWS=8,TYPES=7;
let board=[], selecting=[], particles=[];
let running=false, paused=false, score=0, combo=0, timeLeft=60, skill=0;
let fever=false, feverEnd=0, scoreBoost=false, boostEnd=0, lastClearAt=0, lastTick=0;
let nextTimeBonusScore=5000;
const TIME_BONUS_STEP=5000, TIME_BONUS_SEC=5;
let dpr=1,W=0,H=0,cell=0,ox=0,oy=0,audioCtx=null,soundOn=true;
let lastGravity=0,lastSpawn=0,massDropUntil=0;
const GRAVITY_MS=105, SPAWN_MS=2000, MOVE_MS=190;

function setAppHeight(){document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--appH",innerHeight+"px")}
addEventListener("resize",()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()});
addEventListener("orientationchange",()=>setTimeout(()=>{setAppHeight();resizeCanvas()},180));
setAppHeight();

document.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{if(running)e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("gesturestart",e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false});
document.addEventListener("dblclick",e=>e.preventDefault());

function showScreen(id){
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("active"));
  $(id).classList.add("active");
}
function unlockAudio(){
  try{
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if(!AC) return false;
    if(!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AC();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      const p = audioCtx.resume();
      if(p && typeof p.catch === "function") p.catch(()=>{});
    }
    // iOSで無音バッファを一度鳴らしてロック解除
    if(IS_IOS && audioCtx.createBufferSource){
      const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
      const buf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
      src.buffer = buf;
      src.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      try { src.start(0); } catch(e) {}
    }
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    soundOn = false;
    return false;
  }
}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener("touchstart",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",unlockAudio,{once:true,passive:true});

function beep(freq=500,dur=.06,vol=.03,type="sine"){
  if(!soundOn) return;
  try{
    if(!unlockAudio() || !audioCtx) return;
    const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(), g=audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type=type;
    o.frequency.value=freq;
    g.gain.value=vol;
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const now=audioCtx.currentTime;
    o.start(now);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(vol,.0002), now);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now+dur);
    o.stop(now+dur+.02);
  }catch(e){
    // 音声エラーが出てもゲームは止めない
  }
}
function haptic(v=8){ safeVibrate(v); }

function updateHome(){
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  $("#homeAvatar").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#homeCharName").textContent=c.name;$("#homeCharDesc").textContent=c.desc;$("#homeSkill").textContent="✦ "+c.skill;
  $("#leaderImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#skillName").textContent="SKILL : "+c.skill;
}
function buildCharGrid(){
  const g=$("#charGrid");g.innerHTML="";
  CHARS.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement("button");b.className="charCard"+(i===tempChar?" selected":"");b.dataset.i=i;
    b.style.borderColor=CHAR_COLORS[i].main+"88";
    b.style.boxShadow="0 8px 22px #0005, inset 0 0 0 1px "+CHAR_COLORS[i].glow+"44";
    b.innerHTML=`<img src="${AVATARS[i]}" style="border-color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].main}"><div><strong style="color:${CHAR_COLORS[i].light}">${c.name}</strong><small>${c.skill}<br>${c.desc}</small></div><i class="check">✓</i>`;
    b.onclick=()=>{tempChar=i;buildCharGrid();beep(540+i*35,.04,.02)};
    g.appendChild(b);
  })
}

setTimeout(()=>{$("#boot").style.display="none";updateHome();startGame()},0);

$("#playBtn").onclick=()=>startGame();
$("#selectBtn").onclick=()=>{tempChar=selectedChar;buildCharGrid();showScreen("#select")};
$("#selectBack").onclick=()=>showScreen("#home");
$("#confirmChar").onclick=()=>{
  selectedChar=tempChar;localStorage.setItem("familyLeader",selectedChar);updateHome();showScreen("#home");beep(760,.08,.03);haptic(12)
};

function randType(){return Math.floor(Math.random()*TYPES)}
function makeCell(fromRow=null){return {type:randType(),moveFromRow:fromRow,moveStart:performance.now()}}
function resetBoard(){board=Array.from({length:ROWS},()=>Array.from({length:COLS},makeCell));selecting=[];particles=[]}
function resizeCanvas(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(); if(!r.width||!r.height)return;
  dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.floor(r.width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.floor(r.height*dpr);
  canvas.style.width=r.width+"px";canvas.style.height=r.height+"px";ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  W=r.width;H=r.height;cell=Math.min(W/COLS,H/ROWS);ox=(W-cell*COLS)/2;oy=(H-cell*ROWS)/2;
}
function pos(r,c){
  const stagger=(r%2?cell*.08:-cell*.04);
  return{x:ox+c*cell+cell/2+stagger,y:oy+r*cell+cell/2}
}
function hit(x,y){
  const c=Math.floor((x-ox)/cell),r=Math.floor((y-oy)/cell);if(r<0||r>=ROWS||c<0||c>=COLS)return null;
  const p=pos(r,c),dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y;return dx*dx+dy*dy<=(cell*.43)**2?{r,c}:null;
}
function same(a,b){return a&&b&&a.r===b.r&&a.c===b.c}
function adj(a,b){return Math.max(Math.abs(a.r-b.r),Math.abs(a.c-b.c))<=1}
function selIndex(h){return selecting.findIndex(v=>same(v,h))}
function pointerXY(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  if(!running||paused)return;try{ if(canvas.setPointerCapture) canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(_e){}const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);
  if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){selecting=[h];beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);haptic(4)}
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
  if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;const p=pointerXY(e),h=hit(p.x,p.y);if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c])return;
  const last=selecting.at(-1);if(same(h,last))return;
  if(selecting.length>=2&&same(h,selecting.at(-2))){selecting.pop();return}
  if(selIndex(h)>=0)return;
  const first=selecting[0];if(adj(last,h)&&board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){selecting.push(h);beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);haptic(3)}
});
function pointerEnd(){if(!running||paused||!selecting.length)return;if(selecting.length>=3)clearChain(selecting);else beep(150,.06,.018,"square");selecting=[]}
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup",pointerEnd);
canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel",pointerEnd);

// Pointer Events非対応端末向け Touch Events フォールバック
if(!SUPPORTS_POINTER){
  let touchActive=false;

  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e=>{
    if(!running||paused) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(h&&board[h.r][h.c]){
      selecting=[h];
      touchActive=true;
      beep(320+board[h.r][h.c].type*30,.025,.018);
      haptic(4);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e=>{
    if(!running||paused||!touchActive||!selecting.length) return;
    const t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p={x:t.clientX-r.left,y:t.clientY-r.top};
    const h=hit(p.x,p.y);
    if(!h||!board[h.r][h.c]) return;

    const last=selecting[selecting.length-1];
    if(same(h,last)) return;

    if(selecting.length>=2 && same(h,selecting[selecting.length-2])){
      selecting.pop();
      return;
    }
    if(selIndex(h)>=0) return;

    const first=selecting[0];
    if(adj(last,h) && board[h.r][h.c].type===board[first.r][first.c].type){
      selecting.push(h);
      beep(350+selecting.length*24,.025,.015);
      haptic(3);
    }
  },{passive:false});

  const endTouch=()=>{
    if(!touchActive) return;
    touchActive=false;
    pointerEnd();
  };
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend",endTouch,{passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel",endTouch,{passive:false});
}


function addParticles(r,c,type,n=8){ if(LOW_FX) n=Math.min(n,3);
  const p=pos(r,c);for(let k=0;k<n;k++)particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4-1,life:1,type})
}
function clearCells(set,baseN=3,withScore=true){
  let count=0;for(const key of set){const[r,c]=key.split(",").map(Number);if(board[r]?.[c]){addParticles(r,c,board[r][c].type);board[r][c]=null;count++}}
  if(withScore&&count){
    let multi=1;if(fever)multi*=2;if(scoreBoost)multi*=3;
    score+=Math.round((baseN*baseN*10+count*9)*(1+Math.min(combo,12)*.05)*multi);
    $("#score").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");

    // 5,000点到達ごとに残り時間を5秒回復
    let bonusCount=0;
    while(score>=nextTimeBonusScore){
      bonusCount++;
      nextTimeBonusScore+=TIME_BONUS_STEP;
    }
    if(bonusCount>0){
      const addSec=TIME_BONUS_SEC*bonusCount;
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+addSec);
      $("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;
      showToast("SCORE BONUS +" + addSec + " SEC");
      beep(1040,.10,.035,"sine");
      setTimeout(()=>beep(1280,.12,.03,"sine"),90);
      haptic([12,18,18]);
    }
  }
  return count;
}
function clearChain(chain){
  const now=performance.now();combo=(now-lastClearAt<2200)?combo+1:1;lastClearAt=now;$("#comboNum").textContent=combo;
  const set=new Set(chain.map(p=>p.r+","+p.c));
  if(chain.length>=7){const z=chain.at(-1);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let r=z.r+dr,c=z.c+dc;if(r>=0&&r<ROWS&&c>=0&&c<COLS)set.add(r+","+c)}showToast("BOMB!")}
  const n=clearCells(set,chain.length,true);
  skill=Math.min(100,skill+n*5.4);updateSkill();
  beep(470+n*16,.07,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(660+n*12,.07,.025),45);
  wrap.animate(
    [{transform:"scale(1)"},{transform:"scale(1.008)"},{transform:"scale(1)"}],
    {duration:160,easing:"ease-out"}
  );
  haptic(chain.length>=7?[14,20,20]:8);
  if(chain.length>=12&&!fever)startFever();
}
function gravityStep(){
  let moved=false;
  for(let r=ROWS-1;r>=1;r--){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(!board[r][c] && board[r-1][c]){
        const b=board[r-1][c];
        board[r][c]=b;
        board[r-1][c]=null;
        b.moveFromRow=r-1;
        b.moveStart=performance.now();
        moved=true;
      }
    }
  }
  return moved;
}
function spawnOne(){
  const candidates=[];
  for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    if(!board[0][c]) candidates.push(c);
  }
  if(!candidates.length) return false;
  const c=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
  board[0][c]=makeCell(-1);
  return true;
}
function occupiedCount(){
  let n=0;
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])n++;
  return n;
}
function updateSkill(){
  $("#skillFill").style.width=skill+"%";$("#skillPct").textContent="SKILL "+Math.floor(skill)+"%";$("#skillBtn").classList.toggle("ready",skill>=100)
}
function randomCells(n){
  const a=[];for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c])a.push([r,c]);
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}
  return a.slice(0,n)
}
function skillAnimation(){
  $("#fxImg").src=AVATARS[selectedChar];$("#fxName").textContent=CHARS[selectedChar].skill;$("#skillFx").classList.add("show");
  beep(760,.12,.045);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.15,.04),100);setTimeout(()=>$("#skillFx").classList.remove("show"),1000)
}
function useSkill(){
  if(!running||paused||skill<100)return;skill=0;updateSkill();skillAnimation();haptic([20,30,35]);
  const c=CHARS[selectedChar];
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(c.type==="heartclear"){
      showHeartClear();
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const s=new Set();
        for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
          for(let col=0;col<COLS;col++){
            if(board[r][col]) s.add(r+","+col);
          }
        }
        clearCells(s,22,true);
        showToast("♥ ALL CLEAR ♥");
        haptic([25,30,45]);

        // 全消しの余韻のあと、約半分を一気に上から降らせる
        setTimeout(()=>massDropHalfBoard(),520);
      },260)
    }else if(c.type==="time"){
      timeLeft=Math.min(99,timeLeft+5);$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;const s=new Set(randomCells(6).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,6,true);showToast("+5 SEC")
    }else if(c.type==="bomb"){
      let s=new Set();for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const r=Math.floor(Math.random()*ROWS),col=Math.floor(Math.random()*COLS);for(let dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(let dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){let rr=r+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr>=0&&rr<ROWS&&cc>=0&&cc<COLS)s.add(rr+","+cc)}}clearCells(s,10,true)
    }else if(c.type==="boost"){
      scoreBoost=true;boostEnd=performance.now()+7000;showToast("SCORE ×3")
    }else if(c.type==="convert"){
      randomCells(8).forEach(([r,col])=>{if(board[r][col])board[r][col].type=selectedChar});showToast("COLOR CHANGE")
    }else if(c.type==="fever"){
      startFever()
    }else if(c.type==="clear"){
      const s=new Set(randomCells(18).map(([r,col])=>r+","+col));clearCells(s,12,true);showToast("ALL CLEAR!")
    }
  },420)
}
$("#skillBtn").onclick=useSkill;

function startFever(){
  // FEVER突入時：画面上のキャラをすべて消す
  const all = new Set();
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      if(board[r][c]) all.add(r+","+c);
    }
  }
  clearCells(all, 20, true);

  fever=true;
  feverEnd=performance.now()+8000;
  $("#feverFx").classList.add("on");
  showToast("FEVER! ALL CLEAR");
  beep(900,.14,.04);
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1150,.18,.04),120);
  haptic([25,35,45]);
}
function stopFever(){fever=false;$("#feverFx").classList.remove("on")}
function showToast(t){const e=$("#toast");e.textContent=t;e.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(showToast.t);showToast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove("show"),650)}

function showHeartClear(){
  const fx=$("#heartClearFx");
  fx.querySelectorAll(".spark").forEach(e=>e.remove());
  const marks=["♥","✦","♡","✧","♥","✦","♡","✧"];
  marks.forEach((m,i)=>{
    const s=document.createElement("span");
    s.className="spark";
    s.textContent=m;
    const a=(Math.PI*2/marks.length)*i;
    const d=90+Math.random()*85;
    s.style.setProperty("--dx",Math.cos(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.setProperty("--dy",Math.sin(a)*d+"px");
    s.style.left="50%";s.style.top="50%";
    s.style.marginLeft="-12px";s.style.marginTop="-12px";
    fx.appendChild(s);
  });
  fx.classList.remove("show");
  void fx.offsetWidth;
  fx.classList.add("show");
  beep(880,.11,.04,"sine");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(1180,.16,.04,"triangle"),100);
  setTimeout(()=>fx.classList.remove("show"),850);
}


function massDropHalfBoard(){
  // 盤面の約半分＝下4段×6列＝24個を、上空から一斉に降らせる
  const start=performance.now();
  for(let r=ROWS-4;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      const b=makeCell(-4-Math.random()*2);
      b.moveStart=start;
      board[r][c]=b;
    }
  }
  // 一斉落下アニメーション中は通常重力/1個ずつ補充を一時停止
  massDropUntil=start+520;
  lastGravity=massDropUntil;
  lastSpawn=massDropUntil;
  showToast("♥ HALF DROP! ♥");
  beep(720,.08,.035,"triangle");
  setTimeout(()=>beep(920,.10,.03,"triangle"),90);
  haptic([18,24,28]);
}


function drawAvatar(im,x,y,r,selected,phase=0,type=0){
  ctx.save();

  const col=CHAR_COLORS[type]||CHAR_COLORS[0];
  const fit=FACE_FITS[type]||FACE_FITS[0];
  const t=performance.now();
  const bob=Math.sin(t/520+phase)*1.5;
  const squish=selected?1.06:(1+Math.sin(t/680+phase)*0.01);

  ctx.translate(x,y+bob);
  ctx.scale(squish,1/squish*1.01);

  const br=r*fit.body;

  // 影
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=.32;
  ctx.fillStyle="#000";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,br*.73,br*.72,br*.28,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  if(!LOW_FX) ctx.filter="blur(5px)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // ぬいぐるみ本体
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor=selected?"#fff":col.glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur=selected?20:11;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-br,-br,br,br);
  g.addColorStop(0,col.light);
  g.addColorStop(.50,"#fff");
  g.addColorStop(1,col.main);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // 手
  ctx.fillStyle=col.light;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(-br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,-.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(br*.78,br*.20,br*.19,br*.12,.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  // 顔表示：キャラごとに輪郭へ合わせた楕円＋個別拡大
  ctx.save();
  const fx=br*fit.ovalX, fy=br*fit.ovalY;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.clip();

  if(im.complete){
    const iw=im.naturalWidth, ih=im.naturalHeight;
    const base=Math.min((fx*2)/iw,(fy*2)/ih);
    const s=base*fit.scale;
    const dw=iw*s, dh=ih*s;
    const dx=-dw/2 + br*fit.x;
    const dy=-dh/2 - br*.03 + br*fit.y;
    ctx.drawImage(im,dx,dy,dw,dh);
  }

  const shine=ctx.createRadialGradient(-br*.30,-br*.38,2,-br*.18,-br*.23,br*.68);
  shine.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.42)");
  shine.addColorStop(.45,"rgba(255,255,255,.07)");
  shine.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=shine;
  ctx.fillRect(-br,-br,br*2,br*2);
  ctx.restore();

  // 顔輪郭の縁取り
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.88)";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,-br*.03,fx,fy,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // 本体のキャラ色枠
  ctx.strokeStyle=selected?"#fff36a":col.main;
  ctx.lineWidth=selected?5:4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,br,br*.88,0,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();

  if(selected){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle=col.glow;
    ctx.lineWidth=6;
    ctx.shadowColor=col.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0,0,br*1.10,br*.98,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.12;ctx.fillStyle="#6edfff";for(let y=15;y<H;y+=34)for(let x=15;x<W;x+=34){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore();
  if(selecting.length>1){ctx.save();
    const chainType=board[selecting[0].r][selecting[0].c].type;
    const chainColor=CHAR_COLORS[chainType].glow;
    ctx.strokeStyle=chainColor;
    ctx.lineWidth=10;
    ctx.lineCap="round";
    ctx.lineJoin="round";
    ctx.shadowColor=chainColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur=20;ctx.beginPath();selecting.forEach((q,i)=>{const p=pos(q.r,q.c);i?ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y):ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)});ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    const b=board[r]?.[c];if(!b)continue;
    const p=pos(r,c),idx=selIndex({r,c});
    let py=p.y;
    if(b.moveFromRow!==null && b.moveFromRow!==undefined){
      const t=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-b.moveStart)/MOVE_MS);
      const ease=t<.78 ? 1-Math.pow(1-t/.78,3) : 1 + Math.sin((t-.78)/.22*Math.PI)*.05*(1-(t-.78)/.22);
      const fromY=oy+b.moveFromRow*cell+cell/2;
      py=fromY+(p.y-fromY)*ease;
      if(t>=1)b.moveFromRow=null;
    }
    drawAvatar(images[b.type],p.x,py,cell*.405*(idx>=0?1.05:1),idx>=0,(r*7+c)*0.67,b.type);
    if(idx>=0){
      ctx.save();
      const rr=Math.max(10,cell*.15);
      ctx.fillStyle=CHAR_COLORS[b.type].main;
      ctx.shadowColor="#000";ctx.shadowBlur=6;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,py,rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle="#fff";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
      ctx.font=`900 ${Math.max(11,cell*.18)}px system-ui`;
      ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
      ctx.fillText(idx+1,p.x,py);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=.05;p.life-=.035;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);ctx.fillStyle=["#ff6bde","#62eaff","#ffe35c","#8dff7a","#ff8e6a","#b98bff","#fff"][p.type%7];ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,4+4*p.life,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0)
}
let __lastFrame=0;
function loop(ts){
  if(LOW_FX && ts-__lastFrame<33){requestAnimationFrame(loop);return;}
  __lastFrame=ts;
  draw();
  if(running&&!paused){
    if(!lastTick)lastTick=ts;
    if(ts-lastTick>=1000){const n=Math.floor((ts-lastTick)/1000);timeLeft=Math.max(0,timeLeft-n);lastTick+=n*1000;$("#timer").textContent=timeLeft;if(timeLeft<=10)$("#timer").style.color="#ffe15a";if(timeLeft<=0)finishGame()}
    const now=performance.now();
    if(!lastGravity)lastGravity=now;
    if(!lastSpawn)lastSpawn=now;
    if(now>=massDropUntil){
      if(now-lastGravity>=GRAVITY_MS){
        gravityStep();
        lastGravity=now;
      }
      if(now-lastSpawn>=SPAWN_MS){
        if(occupiedCount()<ROWS*COLS) spawnOne();
        lastSpawn=now;
      }
    }
    if(fever&&now>=feverEnd)stopFever();
    if(scoreBoost&&now>=boostEnd){scoreBoost=false;showToast("BOOST END")}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop)
}
function resetGame(){
  score=0;combo=0;timeLeft=60;skill=0;fever=false;scoreBoost=false;lastClearAt=0;lastTick=0;lastGravity=0;lastSpawn=0;massDropUntil=0;nextTimeBonusScore=TIME_BONUS_STEP;paused=false;
  $("#score").textContent="0";$("#comboNum").textContent="0";$("#timer").textContent="60";$("#timer").style.color="white";updateSkill();stopFever();resetBoard()
}
function startGame(){
  unlockAudio();resetGame();updateHome();showScreen("#gameScreen");setTimeout(resizeCanvas,50);running=true;beep(650,.07,.03);setTimeout(()=>beep(850,.09,.03),75);
  try{screen.orientation?.lock?.("portrait").catch(()=>{})}catch(e){}
}
function finishGame(){
  if(!running)return;running=false;let best=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0);if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem("familyLinkBest",best)}
  $("#best").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultScore").textContent=score.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultBest").textContent=best.toLocaleString("ja-JP");$("#resultModal").classList.add("show");beep(220,.2,.04,"triangle")
}
$("#best").textContent=Number(localStorage.getItem("familyLinkBest")||0).toLocaleString("ja-JP");
$("#pauseBtn").onclick=()=>{if(!running)return;paused=true;$("#pauseModal").classList.add("show")};
$("#resumeBtn").onclick=()=>{paused=false;lastTick=performance.now();$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show")};
$("#quitBtn").onclick=()=>{running=false;paused=false;$("#pauseModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#retryBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};
$("#resultHomeBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#resultModal").classList.remove("show");startGame()};

resetBoard();updateHome();requestAnimationFrame(loop);

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{
  if(document.hidden){
    if(running) paused=true;
  }else{
    lastTick=performance.now();
    lastGravity=performance.now();
    lastSpawn=performance.now();
    if(running) paused=false;
    if(bgmEnabled && bgmStarted){
      try{
        if(audioCtx && audioCtx.state==="suspended") audioCtx.resume();
      }catch(e){}
    }
  }
});

// iOSのページキャッシュから復帰した時にもタイマー補正
window.addEventListener("pageshow",()=>{
  lastTick=performance.now();
  lastGravity=performance.now();
  lastSpawn=performance.now();
},{passive:true});


try{
  const b=document.getElementById("compatBadge");
  if(b) b.textContent = LOW_FX ? "互換モード" : "標準モード";
}catch(e){}


const __musicBtn=document.getElementById("musicBtn");
if(__musicBtn){
  __musicBtn.textContent = bgmEnabled ? "♪" : "×";
  __musicBtn.classList.toggle("off", !bgmEnabled);
  __musicBtn.addEventListener("click",(e)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setBGM(!bgmEnabled);
  });
}


if(LOW_FX){
  try{
    if(bgmMaster) bgmMaster.gain.value=.032;
  }catch(e){}
}

</script>
</body>
</html>
